About Us

At Simply Stated Bath & Body, we help busy women turn their everyday routines into micro-rituals through our handcrafted products and subscription boxes. We have a growing online business that includes both retail (direct-to-consumer) and wholesale (business-to-business). 



Our small team values excellence, integrity, and heart. We move fast, think strategically, and care deeply about the impact our work creates for the customer base we serve and the retailers we partner with. 



We are a family owned business out of Colorado and currently have one VA and are now looking to add another dedicated, detail-oriented, and motivated team member to help support our growing operations.



If you’re smart, hard-working, honest, and ready to join a purpose-driven team that moves quickly and celebrates progress, we’d love to meet you.



About The Role

We’re looking for an experienced, proactive Virtual Assistant who is familiar with Google Drive, Google Sheets and Docs, and willing to learn Faire, Shopify, and Etsy (soon to be expanding into that channel). This individual will assist with customer service inbox management, product listing updates across our various sales channels, and support the CEO in other administrative tasks and data entry as the brand continues to grow. 



There are clear written and video SOPs for every recurring task, and attention to detail, reliability, and communication are key to success in this role.



Key Responsibilities

Customer Support

- Weekly follow up on wholesale outreach
s

- Weekly Faire CRM review and send follow up messages

- Respond publicly to Faire reviews

- Respond publicly to Shopify reviews

- Weekly Etsy customer communication



Administrative Tasks

- Update product listings monthly within Shopify, Faire, and Etsy

- Edit alt text on images in Shopify and Etsy

- Resize images for Shopify

title: Virtual Front Desk Assistant – Regenerative Medicine Clinic + General VA Support (Long-Term)
description:
ABOUT US

We are Integrative Medical, a regenerative medicine clinic in the Phoenix, AZ, Metro area. We have been serving our community since 2012, and we pride ourselves on warm patient experience, efficient care, and personalized attention. Our small team values professionalism, kindness, accountability, and getting things done right the first time.



WE ARE HIRING A VIRTUAL FRONT DESK ASSISTANT

A friendly, sharp, and proactive VA to be the front-desk voice of our clinic — and to help with other projects during idle time. This is a long-term role for someone who wants stability, variety, and a workplace that values upbeat, solution-oriented people.



ABOUT THE ROLE

You'll be the first point of contact for patients calling our clinic. Between calls, you'll handle scheduling, administrative work, outreach to new patients and clients, and a rotating mix of VA tasks for other projects we run. No two days look exactly the same.



We'll provide structured onboarding, SOPs, and training on our systems — you don't need to know our specific tools on day one, but you do need to be a fast learner.



WHAT YOU'LL DO (CLINIC)

- Answer incoming patient calls professionally and warmly

- Schedule, reschedule, and confirm appointments

- Handle administrative tasks using office software (Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, etc.)

- New patient onboarding and outreach (calls,
s, follow-ups)

- New client outreach and lead follow-up

- Other front-desk and admin duties as needed



WHAT YOU'LL DO (OTHER PROJECTS, DURING IDLE TIME)

- General virtual assistant tasks across our other business projects

- Research, data entry,
 management, document prep, light project coordination

- Whatever is needed to keep things moving — we'll always brief you clearly



This varied mix is part of the role itself. As you grow into the position and demonstrate strong performance, responsibilities and pay can expand over time.



TEAM & REPORTING

You'll be our first and only VA hire, reporting directly to the doctor. Your day-to-day interactions will primarily be with patients and other callers — you'll be the front-line voice of the clinic.



MUST-HAVES

- Excellent spoken English — clear, neutral, easy to understand on the phone

- Excellent written English — professional, error-free
s and messages

- Upbeat, cheerful, positive personality (this matters — patients can hear it)

- Proactive and solution-oriented — you spot problems and bring fixes, not just questions

- Comfortable with office software (Google Workspace and/or MS Office, calendar tools, spreadsheets, basic docs)

- Reliable internet, quiet workspace, working headset, and a backup power/internet plan

- Long-term commitment — we are not looking for short-term help

- Comfortable handling confidential patient information. As a medical clinic, we operate under HIPAA. You'll be required to sign a confidentiality agreement and Business Associate Agreement (BAA) before you start, and to follow our patient privacy protocols on every call and every record.

- Able to work US business hours: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM Phoenix/Arizona time (roughly 12:00 AM – 9:00 AM Manila time). Please only apply if you're confident you can work and thrive on this schedule long-term.



NICE-TO-HAVES

- Prior experience in a medical, dental, or healthcare front-desk role

- Experience with US clients

- Familiarity with EMR/EHR systems, scheduling platforms, or VoIP phone systems

- Experience with CRMs or outreach tools



EQUIPMENT & TOOLS

You provide:

- A capable computer that can smoothly handle VoIP calls while running our CRM, EHR, and office software at the same time (minimum 8GB RAM, ideally 16GB; modern processor; Windows or Mac)

- An excellent noise-cancelling USB headset — clear audio quality is essential since you'll be speaking with patients

- High-speed, reliable internet (at least 25 Mbps) with a backup connection (second ISP or mobile hotspot)

- UPS or backup power for brownouts

- A quiet, private, distraction-free workspace — this means a home office or dedicated room. Working from a call center, BPO floor, or shared workspace is not acceptable — patients must hear only you on the line.



We provide: All clinic software and logins (EHR, scheduling, CRM), a HIPAA-compliant VoIP phone system for patient calls, training materials, and SOPs.



SCHEDULE & COMPENSATION

- Hours: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM Phoenix/Arizona time (8.5 hours work + 30-minute unpaid lunch break)

- Type: Full-time (42.5 hours/week paid)

- Pay: $500–$650/month USD, based on experience

- 90-day probation period. During this time, we'll evaluate fit on both sides. After successfully completing probation, you'll receive a formal performance review, paid time off and sick leave begin accruing, and the 13th month bonus becomes effective.

- Performance-based raises after probation, with annual reviews thereafter



PAID TIME OFF (after 90-day probation)

- 10 days paid vacation per year, accruing monthly

- 5 days paid sick leave per year

- Paid time off when the clinic is closed for US holidays (you work your regular schedule on days the clinic is open)



PAYMENT

- Paid in USD, semi-monthly on the 1st and 16th of each month

- Sent via Remitly, received in your GCash wallet

- 13th month bonus paid in mid-December



START DATE

We're aiming to fill this role within 4–6 weeks of posting. We're willing to wait for the right long-term fit, including reasonable notice periods if you're currently employed.



HOW TO APPLY

Please send the following:

1. A short message telling me why this role is a fit for you

2. Your resume / CV

3. A short video (3–5 minutes) where you:

   - Introduce yourself

   - Walk me through your work experience

   - Share your top skills and strengths

   - Share one honest weakness you're working on



To show you actually read this post, please open your application with two things:

1. Your current time zone, and confirmation you can work the hours listed above

2. One specific thing from this post that made you want to apply for this role



Applications that skip these will not be reviewed.



HIRING PROCESS

1. Application review (we'll respond to shortlisted candidates within 7 days of applying)

2. 15-minute video screening call

3. Paid trial task (small, paid at the hourly equivalent of the role)

4. Final interview and offer



Looking forward to meeting you!

title: Marketing and Delivery Assistant
description:
OPULENCE  DESIGNS

Delivery Coordinator + Marketing Assistant

Part-time contractor  ·  Remote, Latin America  ·  10–20 hrs/week



Role type Part-time contractor, 10 to 20 hours per week

Location Remote, anywhere in Latin America

Pay $5 to $7 per hour, based on experience

Start date Immediate, as soon as we find the right fit

Reports to Jill Johnson, Founder

Trial period 30 days

Time zone overlap Minimum 3 hours daily with Mountain Time (Edmonton, Canada)

English level B2 or higher (written, client-facing)



About Opulence Designs

Opulence Designs is a marketing and design consultancy that builds booking systems for high-end event venue owners and event planners. We work with clients running residential and commercial event businesses with budgets above $100k. Our 120-day program installs offer clarity, repositions visuals, runs follow-up sprints, and lands clients new bookings under a system they can run on their own once we step out.



I am Jill, the founder. I built this business from scratch. I run client calls, I write the strategy, I deliver the creative work, and I handle the day-to-day. Right now I am the bottleneck. I need someone next to me who can hold the system in place while I stay focused on the work that only I can do.



What this role is

You are the person who makes sure every client step gets done on time. You track where each client is in their 30-day onboarding, send the reminders, prep the worksheets, and follow up when something is sitting too long. You also help me with marketing prep, billing, scheduling, and the daily admin that keeps the business running.



This is a coordination role. The strategy is mine. The execution belongs to both of us, and your job is to keep it moving every single day.



What you will do in a typical week

A normal week sits in five buckets. Some weeks you will be heavier in one bucket than another, depending on where clients are in their phase.



1. Client delivery and SOP execution

?  Run point on client delivery across our Month 1 to Month 4 process (Onboarding, Offer Clarity, 10-Day Sprint, First Booking).

?  Track every client’s status against the SOP checklist and the Miro client journey board.

?  Send pre-call reminders, prep workbook templates, upload assets to each client’s shared folder, and confirm everything is in place 24 hours before our session.

?  Flag anything sitting longer than it should, before it slips into next week.



2. Marketing prep and content support

?  Build out content calendars in Google Sheets from my voice notes, written outlines, Loom recordings, or short briefs

?  Use ChatGPT or Claude to draft first-pass captions,
 follow-ups, short-form ad copy, and weekly content briefs from the brand voice guide. Most of this writing starts as AI output that you sharpen. You need to prompt cleanly and edit the result so it sounds like Opulence, not like Ai.



3. Billing and admin

?  Send invoices and follow up on outstanding balances through CC360 or Stripe.

?  Track payments against active contracts and flag anything past 7 days overdue.

?  Keep the client roster, contact info, contract dates, and renewal milestones current in our CRM.

?  Update Calendar and send invites to prospective clients. 



4. Scheduling and client communication

?  Schedule and confirm discovery calls, kickoff calls, weekly 1:1s, and create meeting schedule for client working sessions based on where they are at, action item focused. 

?  Respond to basic client admin questions in our shared chat (calendar links, file requests, login resets, meeting prep notes).

?  Send weekly recap notes to clients after each session, pulled from my call summaries.



5. Reporting and weekly review

?  Pull a Monday morning report on inquiries, bookings, payments, and client status so we start the week aligned.

?  Update our internal dashboard with week-over-week numbers.



Who this role is for

?  You are organized to the point that an unchecked task feels physically uncomfortable.

?  You have run admin or client coordination work before, ideally inside a creative agency, marketing firm, hospitality business, or events company.

?  You have a working command of Claude. You can write a clean prompt that gets you 80% of the way there, and you know how to edit AI output so it does not sound like AI.

?  You have a real eye for marketing and sales. You know what a good caption looks like, you can spot when a follow-up sounds desperate, you catch a typo at 50 feet, and you can tell when a subject line is going to flop.

?  You are comfortable in Google Workspace, Miro, Canva, CC360 (or a similar CRM), whatsapp, notion, and Loom.

?  Your written English is strong, B2 or higher. You will be drafting client-facing
s, captions, and reminders in English.

?  You can work 2 to 4 hours per day with a minimum of 3 hours overlapping Mountain Time, Monday through Thursday some weekend availability; Sunday meeting weekly prep call. 



Who this role is not for

?  You want to learn marketing on the job. This role assumes you already have a working eye for it.

?  You need step-by-step instructions for every task. I will give you the SOPs and the brand voice guide. You take it from there.

?  You are juggling three other clients and this is a side hustle. I need consistent presence, same hours, same days.

?  You are uncomfortable holding clients accountable to deadlines. A piece of this job is following up on people who have not returned their workbook.



Bonus points if

?  You have worked with wedding planners, event venues, hospitality groups, or boutique creative agencies before.

?  You have light video editing skills (Reels, TikTok captions, simple cuts in CapCut or Descript, basic captioning work).

?  You have used Notion for project management.

?  You have a working understanding of the wedding and events industry vocabulary.

?  You have built a content calendar from scratch for a previous client.



Tools we use

Google Workspace (Drive, Docs, Sheets, Calendar), Miro, Course Creator 360, Stripe, Adobe Cloud, Canva, ChatGPT, Claude, Notion, and other project management tools.



You do not need expert-level skill in all of them. You need to be the kind of person who picks up a new tool inside a week.



Logistics

?  10 to 20 hours per week, with room to grow as the business grows.

?  $5 to $8 USD per hour, paid every two weeks via Wise or Stripe.

?  Contractor agreement with a 30-day trial period.

?  Start date is immediate. I am ready to onboard the right person this month.

?  You bring your own laptop, headset, reliable internet, and a quiet workspace for calls.



How to apply

Send your application to 
 with the subject line: Delivery Coordinator + your first name.

Include the four items below. Applications missing the Loom or the scenario answer will not be reviewed. Apply here 
 as well. 



1.  A short Loom video (90 seconds maximum) telling me why you want this role, what kind of client work you have coordinated before, one moment you are proud of, and the kind of business owner you do your best work for.



2.  A one-paragraph answer to this scenario: A client is supposed to send back their onboarding workbook by Friday so we can run their kickoff call on Monday. It is now Wednesday and they have not returned it. Walk me through exactly what you do, what you say, and what you flag to me.



3.  The name of one tool you have used to track client work, and one sentence on what you liked or did not like about it.



4.  Your hourly rate in USD and how many hours per week you can commit.



I read every application personally. The strongest applications come from people who treat this submission the way they would treat a real client deliverable.



Jill Johnson

Founder, Opulence Designs


  ·  Refining your legacy

title: Graphic Designer
description:
Fluid Focus is a mobile app (iOS and Android) that helps people reduce screen time and build better focus habits - and rewards them for doing it. We're rated 4.9 stars across 177 countries, trusted by universities worldwide, and backed by behavioural science research from the University of Liverpool. Our users earn real rewards (cash prizes, wellness vouchers, charity donations) for every minute they stay focused.



We're a small, fast-moving team building something meaningful. We need a designer who can make our brand look as good as the product feels.



We're looking for a part-time graphic designer to create a range of visual assets across marketing, sales, and product. This is not a social media content mill - the work is varied, strategic, and brand-led. You'll be designing materials that go in front of university decision-makers, enterprise clients, app store browsers, and end users.



What you'll be designing:

 campaign graphics and headers. 

Sales brochures and one-pagers for education and enterprise markets. 

Pitch deck slides and presentation assets. 

App Store and Google Play screenshot mockups. 

Event materials (flyers, banners, digital handouts). 

Internal documents that need to look external-quality. 

Social media assets as needed. 

Occasional web graphics and landing page visuals.



What you won't be doing:

UI/UX design for the app itself (we have a separate product team for that). Video editing. Copywriting (we'll provide the copy — you bring it to life visually).



What We're Looking For:



1. Clean, professional brand design

You understand how to make a startup look credible, polished, and trustworthy — not corporate, not scrappy. Think clean layouts, confident typography, intentional white space, and restrained colour use. If your portfolio is full of over-decorated templates with stock photos and drop shadows, this isn't the right fit. If your portfolio shows work that could sit on a well-funded tech startup's website or pitch deck, keep reading.



2. Multi-format versatility

You're comfortable moving between formats in a single week - a brochure layout on Monday, an
 header on Tuesday, a presentation slide on Wednesday, a social graphic on Thursday. You don't need hand-holding on dimensions, bleed, or export settings. You know the difference between designing for print versus screen, and you've worked across tools like Figma, Canva, and Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign).



3. Brand consistency without a rulebook

We have brand guidelines (colours, typography, tone), but we don't have a 200-page brand book with templates for every possible asset. We need someone who can internalise the brand - the feel, the restraint, the confidence - and apply it consistently to new formats without being told exactly how. You'll be the person who makes sure everything that leaves the company looks like it came from the same place.



Requirements



3+ years of professional graphic design experience (agency, in-house, or freelance with a strong portfolio)

Portfolio that demonstrates clean, modern, brand-led design work - not just social media templates



Proficiency in at least two of: Figma, Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, InDesign, Photoshop), Canva Pro



Comfortable working asynchronously with a UK-based team



Reliable internet connection and availability for at least 4 hours of overlap with UK business hours (9am–5pm GMT/BST)



Strong written English for understanding briefs and communicating about design decisions



Able to start within 2 weeks



Thanks

title: Short-Form Video Editor for Founder Content Channel
description:
I'm building a short-form content channel focused on business and ecommerce. I film talking-head videos in vertical (9:16) format and need an editor who can turn that raw footage into scroll-stopping, professionally edited shorts with:



Clean, rhythmic cuts that match the pacing of the script

Animated text overlays and callouts that emphasize key moments

Motion graphics and simple custom animations (charts, comparisons, visual metaphors)

B-roll integration — stock footage, AI-generated images, product shots

Sound design — music beds, SFX on cuts, audio polish

Color grading for a consistent, cinematic look



I'll provide the raw footage, scripts, brand guidelines (colors, fonts, style references), and direction for each video. You bring the craft.



The goal is 2-10 finished videos per week, 30-60 seconds each, formatted vertical for TikTok, Reels, and YouTube Shorts.



What I'm looking for

Required:



2+ years editing short-form vertical content for creators or brands

Strong portfolio with examples of your own short-form work (not just long-form YouTube)

Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve fluency

After Effects skills for text animation and motion graphics — this is non-negotiable

Solid sense of pacing, rhythm, and when to cut

Sound design instincts — you understand that audio is 50% of the edit

Reliable communication and on-time delivery

Comfortable working async (we may be in different time zones)

Conversational English — you need to understand nuanced creative feedback



Bonus:



Color grading skills (Lumetri or DaVinci Color)

Photoshop or Illustrator for asset creation

Experience with creator/founder content specifically (not corporate or wedding video)

Familiarity with current short-form trends without copying them





Style references

These are the exact style and quality level I'm aiming for. Please watch all three before applying:











If your work doesn't look like it could sit next to these, this role isn't the right fit for you. That's not a judgment — these editors are at a specific level and that's the bar.



What this role is NOT

Filtering hard so we don't waste each other's time:



Not a "I edit YouTube long-form and can also do shorts" role. This is specialist work.

Not for editors who only do jump-cut talking head with no motion graphics.

Not for editors who need shot-by-shot instructions for every cut. I'll give you the script, the brand system, and creative direction. You bring the craft.

Not for editors who deliver and ghost. I want a long-term collaborator who improves with every video.





How to apply

To save us both time, only apply if you can do all of these:

1. Send your portfolio. Specifically the link to your short-form vertical work. If your portfolio is mostly horizontal YouTube content, you can still apply but include vertical examples.

2. Pick one video from your portfolio and tell me:



What was the creative choice you're most proud of?

What would you do differently if you re-edited it today?



This tells me how you think, not just how you cut.

3. Tell me your rate. Per video or per month. Don't be coy about it, I'm budgeting based on your answer.

4. Tell me your availability. How many videos can you realistically deliver per week? What's your turnaround time?

5. Watch the three style references and tell me which one is closest to your current ability and which one is the bar you're working toward. Honest self-assessment matters here.

6. Include the word "leverage" somewhere in your message. This tells me you actually read the posting.



The trial

If your application makes the shortlist, I'll send:



One raw talking-head video clip

The script

Brand guidelines (fonts, colors, style notes)

A clear deadline (4-5 days)



I'll pay for the trial edit regardless of whether we move forward. Two reasons: it's fair, and it filters out anyone who won't put effort into a paid test.



Based on the trial, if it's a fit, we move to monthly retainer with consistent deliverables.



A note about working with me:



I care about quality more than speed. I'd rather wait an extra day for a polished edit than rush a mediocre one. I give detailed creative direction and clear feedback. 



I respect your craft, your time, and your timezone. When you do great work, I'll tell you. When something isn't landing, I'll explain why so we can grow together.



I'm building a long-term content engine, not a one-off project. If you're looking for a stable, ongoing role with a creative founder, this could be your spot.



Looking forward to seeing your work.

title: Roadside Assistance Inbound Sales & Dispatch Specialist

Inbound Sales & Dispatcher

You will start in a frontline Inbound Sales & Dispatch role, handling incoming calls, assisting distressed customers, and coordinating technicians across Australia.



As you demonstrate strong sales ability, attention to detail, and initiative, you’ll progressively take on operations, quality control, and leadership responsibilities, with a clear pathway to advance into a Sales Manager / Team Leader position.



Key Responsibilities

Core Dispatch & Inbound Sales

- Act as the first point of contact for motorists who have misfuelled their vehicle.

- Use empathy and strong communication skills to convert inbound calls into confirmed bookings.

- Coordinate technicians nationwide using booking platforms and real-time tools.

- Collect deposits, log jobs accurately, and manage cases from start to completion.

- Communicate with customers and technicians via phone, Gmail, Slack, and SMS



Daily Operations & Quality Control

- Support fleet job closures, including managing long wait times when calling for PO numbers.

- Track spill kit usage by collecting all related
s and invoices in Xero (create only, do not send).

- Maintain accuracy in Xero and GeoOp, including:

- Reviewing previous day’s jobs for incomplete entries.

- Identifying jobs not properly closed or not sent to Xero.

- Objection reasons are correctly logged.

- ETAs, phone times, and job numbers are accurate.

- Sales opportunities are identified and closed.

- Discounts are properly logged and ticked.

- Act as a second set of eyes on GeoOp and call logs to catch errors, fill gaps, and prevent missed opportunities.



Documentation & Process Support

- Update fleet documents using new templates for consistency and clarity.

- Assist with process mapping, staff training, and continuous improvement initiatives.



Tech & Customer Support

- Coordinate servo runs and tech card runs to keep dispatch lines clear.

- Take ownership of escalated customer issues requiring extended phone support.

- Be comfortable being on camera during Slack huddles as part of daily operations.

- Participate in Slack huddles during shifts, including training, check-ins, and live support.



The Successful Candidate

- Minimum 2 years’ experience in a call centre, sales, or dispatch role.

- Proven success in sales conversion and customer service.

- Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

- Calm under pressure, with strong empathy for customers in stressful situations.

- Tech-savvy, with proficiency in Google Chrome, Gmail, and Google Workspace.

- Comfortable using Slack, including joining huddles and appearing on camera when required.

- Experience working from home with reliable internet and a quiet workspace.

- Bonus: Experience in automotive, roadside assistance, or mobile repair.

- Bonus: Knowledge of Australian geography.



What’s in It for You

- Fully remote, work-from-home role.

- Work with a growing international client.

- Comprehensive training and ongoing support.

- Clear career progression: Dispatcher ? Sales Manager / Team Leader.

- Supportive, professional team culture.

- Competitive salary with performance-based incentives.

title: Part-Time Shopify Store Builder – Daily Niche General Stores Using Impulse Theme

* All store data and information

* Store niche and direction

* Products or product details

* SOP and workflow instructions

* Required access and tools

* Browser/profile setup instructions

* Guidelines for design, structure and optimization



The stores will mainly be in English and German.



?

Your daily task will be to create a complete Shopify store from scratch or from a provided setup, using the Impulse theme.

* Homepage customization

?

* Shopify store creation

* Shopify Impulse theme

?

We will provide a clear SOP that explains how each store should be created.

You will need to follow the SOP carefully and deliver one complete store per day.

?

Expected output:



1 complete Shopify store per day

?

title: Shopify Store Manager
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a hands-on Shopify Store Manager to own the day-to-day operations of our online store. This is NOT a developer role and NOT a strategy-only role — you will live inside Shopify admin every single day, keeping everything running smoothly across product listings, apps, promotions, landing pages, and store content.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

Upload and manage product listings — titles, descriptions, images, variants, pricing, and inventory

Build and update landing pages using page builder apps (Shogun, GemPages, or similar) for paid traffic, promos, and product launches

Create and manage discount codes, promotions, shipping settings, shipping zones, and payment gateway configuration

Configure and manage Shopify apps including Klaviyo, ReCharge, Okendo, Rebuy, and others

Set up and test cross-sell and upsell offers, subscription plans, and frequency options to increase AOV and LTV

Update collections, category pages, homepage content, and promotional banners

Coordinate with developers on technical projects — scope work, write clear requirements, and ensure delivery

Handle order fulfillment setup and printing configuration

Monitor store performance, flag issues proactively, and troubleshoot app/integration problems



REQUIREMENTS

3+ years as a hands-on Shopify store manager working inside Shopify admin daily (not developer, not strategist)

Experience managing multiple Shopify stores simultaneously

Proficiency with page builder apps — Shogun, GemPages, or similar; able to build mobile-optimized landing pages independently

Hands-on experience configuring Klaviyo, ReCharge, Yotpo/Okendo, and Rebuy (or equivalent apps)

Ability to coordinate with developers and cross-functional teams; can write clear scopes and requirements

Strong attention to detail — product data accuracy, image quality, correct pricing, and consistent formatting

Proficiency with AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, etc.) to increase productivity

Excellent written and spoken English communication skills



NICE TO HAVE

Subscription e-commerce experience

Consumer goods background

Basic graphic design (Canva / Photoshop)

Google Analytics 4 (GA4)

Shopify theme editor experience



AVAILABILITY REQUIREMENT

You must have meaningful overlap with US Pacific Time business hours. Please indicate your available hours in your application.



APPLICATION QUESTIONS

Please answer all four questions in your application. Incomplete applications will not be reviewed.

Are you an independent freelancer who will personally be doing this work, or do you represent an agency? Agency applicants will not be considered.

Walk us through how you've set up and tested cross-sell or upsell offers in Rebuy (or a similar app) — what did you test, where did you place widgets, and how did you measure what was working?

Describe a specific customization you've made in ReCharge — subscription plans, frequency options, discount logic, or the customer portal. Give a concrete example.

Walk us through a landing page you've built — what page builder did you use, what sections did you include, and how did you ensure it performed well on mobile?



Please also send the copy of your RESUME using Google drive link.

title: Real Estate Inside Sales Associate (Cold Caller)
description:
Job Title: Real Estate Inside Sales Associate (Cold Caller)





Are you a high-energy communicator with a natural American accent? We are looking for two (2) elite Cold Callers to join our real estate investment team. Your mission: Connect with U.S. homeowners, build instant rapport, and identify those ready to sell their properties.



This is a performance-driven role for someone who loves the "thrill of the hunt" and wants to earn significant commissions on top of a steady salary.



### Role Overview

Shift: 5 hours per day (25-30 hours per week).

$4/ hour Commission of $50 every close deal





Schedule: Sunday through Friday (6 days/week).



Hours: 3:00 PM – 8:00 PM EST (Primary) or 3:00 PM – 7:00 PM EST.



Compensation:$4/hour weekly pay basis every FRIDAY EST + Performance Commission (paid per signed deal).



### Key Responsibilities

Outbound Prospecting: Making high-volume cold calls to property owners in the U.S.



Lead Qualification: Identifying motivation, property condition, and urgency.



Data Management: Accurately logging every call and update in our CRM.



Strict Compliance: Using our required time-tracker and call-recording software for quality assurance and coaching.



### What We Are Looking For

The "American Sound": Since you are calling U.S. homeowners, a strong American accent and native-level fluency are mandatory. We need people who sound like a neighbor, not a telemarketer.



Resilience: You can handle "No" with a smile and keep your energy high for the next call.



Tech Ready: You must have a reliable, high-speed internet connection, a noise-canceling headset, and a quiet workspace.



Coachability: You are open to having your calls recorded and reviewed to sharpen your sales skills.

Subject Line: Real Estate ISA - [Your Name]

Note: We are hiring two people for this role. If you are a closer who wants a stable salary with the upside of real estate commissions, we want to talk to you!

Summary

SweepstakesPros is a promotions agency serving small and large international clients. We specialize in sweepstakes, contests, and games. We are seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive Attorney / Legal Project Manager to support our legal, compliance, and project-management workflows.

You will collaborate with our internal team, production staff, clients, vendors, and attorneys to help manage the end-to-end administration of promotions, including website launches, rules drafting, winner validation, and prize fulfillment.



Key Responsibilities

Legal Duties (approximately 30% of services)

This role supports legal, compliance, and project-management workflows under the direction of SweepstakesPros and its attorneys. Prior U.S. promotions-law experience is not required, and you will not be expected to provide independent U.S. legal advice. Prior experience with promotions law, sweepstakes/contest compliance, privacy, contracts, or HR-related legal support is helpful but not required. We are looking for someone smart, detail-oriented, eager to learn, and comfortable working closely with attorneys and project teams. Training will be provided.

• Document Drafting & Review: Work with attorneys and assist in drafting, reviewing, and proofreading a wide range of legal documents, including sweepstakes and contest rules, winner affidavits, liability releases, client/vendor correspondence, and related documents, with a focus on accuracy, clarity, and consistency.

• Regulatory Compliance Support: Assist with compliance workflows, legal procedures, filing deadlines, and other compliance steps for U.S. and international promotions, including bonding, registration, and related promotion-administration requirements.

• Corporate Legal Assistance: Work with attorneys and management to support corporate legal by drafting and maintaining policies, HR-related documents, privacy compliance materials, and client and vendor agreements.

• Legal Administrative Support: Coordinate with external attorneys, maintain legal calendars, schedule appointments, coordinate meetings, track deadlines, and handle related administrative tasks.

Project Management Duties (approximately 70% of services)

• Project Planning & Scoping: Help define project objectives, scope, deliverables, and success metrics for promotion projects. Develop and maintain project plans, task lists, and timelines using Asana.

• Full Lifecycle Promotion Management: Help oversee the administration of promotions from launch through completion, including winner validation, vendor logistics, prize fulfillment coordination, and coordination with technical project managers for website builds.

• Client and Team Coordination: Coordinate with internal tea
mbers, clients, vendors, attorneys, and production staff to keep projects moving, identify open items, and help ensure timely completion of deliverables.

• Reporting: Provide regular updates and reports on project status, key milestones, open issues, and potential bottlenecks to the team and relevant stakeholders.



Qualifications & Experience

• Education: Law degree required.

• Legal Experience: Minimum of 3–5 years of legal, compliance, contracts, law-firm, or corporate legal department experience preferred.

• Project Management Experience: Proven experience managing complex projects, deadlines, documents, and workflows from initiation to completion is required.

• Attorney Background: Licensed attorney or attorney-level experience is strongly preferred. Prior U.S. legal experience is helpful but not required.



Skills & Competencies

• Legal Acumen: Solid understanding of legal terminology, legal principles, professional responsibility, confidentiality, and ethical guidelines.

• Organizational Mastery: Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining meticulous records and tracking deadlines carefully.

• Attention to Detail: Strong proofreading, issue-spotting, and document-review skills, with the ability to identify inconsistencies, missing information, and follow-up items.

• Tech Savvy: Proficient in Microsoft Office, especially Word and Excel. Significant experience with Asana or similar project-management tools is a major advantage.

• Communication: Superior written and verbal English skills. You must be able to communicate clearly, professionally, and concisely with tea
mbers, clients, vendors, and attorneys.

• Proactive & Self-Motivated: Ability to work independently during Pacific Time business hours, identify next steps, ask good questions, and follow through with minimal day-to-day supervision.

• Confidentiality: Ability to handle confidential client, consumer, promotion, legal, and business information with care and discretion.

Technical Requirements

• Internet: Stable internet connection, minimum 25 Mbps upload and 50 Mbps download.

• Computer: Reliable computer with minimum Intel i3 CPU or equivalent, i5 or higher preferred, and at least 8GB RAM. SweepstakesPros will provide access to a secure virtual workstation for company systems and project work.

• Hardware: Quality headset or microphone with noise cancellation.

• Workspace: Quiet, professional remote-work environment suitable for video calls, client meetings, and focused document work.



Nature of Relationship

This is a remote, long-term independent contractor opportunity. The contractor will be responsible for complying with applicable tax, licensing, registration, and legal requirements in the contractor’s jurisdiction. Nothing in this posting is intended to create an employment relationship, partnership, joint venture, or agency relationship.

Next Steps

title: Amazon Operations Manager
description:
We're hiring an Amazon Operations Manager. The kind of person who can take the entire Amazon side of a growing brand off the founder's plate and run it like it's theirs.



You'll own the platform end-to-end across our key marketplaces (US, CA, MX, UK, AU, JP). Every listing, every metric, every routine, every deal. You'll cross-check our supply chain. You'll spend roughly one day a week building AI agents and automations that make the function leaner over time. And you'll have full access to Claude and whatever comes next.



This isn't a coordinator role. It's an operator role. If you've already run Amazon ops for a brand at real scale and you want more autonomy, smarter tools, and a founder who'll get out of your way once you've earned it, read on.





YOU SHOULD APPLY IF



You've personally run an Amazon ops function before for a brand doing meaningful volume — owning the operation, not just executing tasks within someone else's

You've run Amazon ops across multiple international marketplaces (not just the US). You understand the quirks of each: VAT, regional compliance, marketplace-specific listing rules, marketplace-specific image uploads, global review sharing etc.

You're AI-fluent. You actively use Claude or similar in your daily work, you're comfortable with agentic workflows, and you can build and refine prompts. Having built automations is a bonus, not required.

You're a natural systems thinker. When you describe past work, you talk in workflows, inputs, decisions, and edge cases

You have deep working knowledge of Seller Central — listings, GTINs, barcodes, FNSKUs, A+ content, brand stores, account health, deals and promotions setup

You're a process person. You believe in checklists, SOPs, and consistent routines

Your written and spoken English is excellent



DON'T APPLY IF



You've only been a coordinator, specialist, or VA on someone else's Amazon team

Your Amazon experience is limited to the US marketplace

You treat AI as "something to dabble with" rather than core to how you work

You can't sit comfortably with routine work. Most days, this job is steady, methodical, and detail-heavy

You need a manager looking over your shoulder to do good work



WHAT YOU'LL DO



Run the platform



Daily, weekly, and monthly operational routines across our marketplaces

Listing maintenance: sizes, secondary images, A+ content, product videos, brand stores

GTIN allocation, barcode setup (FNSKU/UPC/EAN), and resolving barcode failures

Account health monitoring. Keep every dashboard green

Shipment defect resolution. Work the Inbound Performance Dashboard, assess each case, d
 whether to dispute or acknowledge, follow through



Run the marketing execution layer



Set up and run all deals, Brand Tailored Promotions, coupons, tiered discounts, and bundles in Seller Central

Maintain strikethrough pricing on priority ASINs and recover it when it drops off

Audit multi-marketplace pricing consistency — make sure prices land cleanly across all marketplaces after Marketing sets them

Monitor KW rank and conversion rate on priority ASINs; flag anomalies, execute the agreed fix

Keep marketing and supply informed when a deal, badge, or campaign is driving unusual sales activity



Cross-check the supply chain



Act as a sounding board and second pair of eyes on our Supply Manager's forecasting, POs, and shipping plans before they reach the founder

Build deep enough understanding of the supply chain to flag risks she might miss and offer alternatives, not just rubber-stamp



Build and improve the function



Spend roughly one day per week building, deploying, and refining AI automations that reduce manual work across the function

Stay current with Amazon platform changes and bring them into the workflow

Refine routines, SOPs, and processes as the operation evolves

Bring ideas, process improvements, expansion opportunities, smarter ways of working



BONUS SKILLS (nice, not required)



Familiarity with Claude Code/Cowork or other agentic developer tools

Experience with Sellerboard, DataDive, Datarova or similar Amazon analytics tools

Background in consumer electronics or adjacent product categories



WHERE YOU FIT



You report directly to the founder

You don't have direct reports. You'll work alongside our Supply Manager (a long-tenured tea
mber) as a cross-check on her work.

You'll work closely with the founder on marketing strategy and deal planning until we hire a Marketing Manager; once they're in place, the seam is Marketing d
, Ops executes

You'll touch Customer Service where account health and customer there is overlap, and know when to escalate to Amazon Seller Support directly.





BENEFITS



US$1,800-$2,200/month, paid monthly

Annual performance review with discretionary bonus tied to KPI delivery

40 hours/week, fixed schedule with 4+ hours of overlap with AEST/AEDT (more during onboarding)

Work from anywhere in the world; manage your own hours within the overlap window

3-month probation; long-term engagement thereafter

Direct line to the founder and a real seat at the table as we grow

Job security: We have been in e-commerce since 2017 and we're hiring because we're scaling, not because something broke

title: Senior Full Stack Developer (Java & Angular)
description:
About the Company

We are a U.S.-based software company dedicated to the mortgage industry. We build reliable, scalable systems that support mission-critical servicing workflows. Our engineering culture values technical excellence, long-term ownership, and clear execution. We operate in a collaborative, fast-moving environment where experienced engineers are trusted to make architectural decisions and drive the product forward.



Position Overview

We are seeking a highly experienced Senior Full Stack Developer to join our core engineering team. This is a role for a professional who thrives on building large-scale systems and is looking for a stable, long-term home. You will have significant responsibility across the entire stack—from architecting complex Java backends to crafting seamless Angular frontends.



Note: We are looking for a teammate who is fully committed and ready to dedicate their professional focus to our mission.



Key Responsibilities

End-to-End Development: Design, develop, and maintain high-performance services using Java (Spring Boot) and Angular.



Backend Architecture: Architect and scale APIs and microservices using GraphQL and REST.



Data Modeling: Design and optimize DynamoDB schemas, queries, and indexing strategies.



Front-End Excellence: Build responsive, state-managed UI components in Angular that provide a superior user experience.



System Integrity: Improve system reliability, observability, and fault tolerance within an event-driven architecture.

Required Qualifications

Backend: Strong expertise in Java and the Spring Boot ecosystem.



Frontend: Advanced proficiency in Angular (TypeScript) and modern web technologies.



API & Data: Proven experience with GraphQL and DynamoDB (or similar NoSQL databases).



Cloud: Hands-on experience with AWS (Lambda, SQS, API Gateway, and DynamoDB).



Reliability: Experience with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and DevOps practices.



Commitment: Proven track record of dedication to a team and the ability to manage a full-time workload effectively.



Preferred Qualifications

Experience with messaging systems like Kafka or RabbitMQ.



Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, and Infrastructure-as-Code.



Understanding of Domain-Driven Design (DDD) and CQRS patterns.



Why Join Us?

Stability & Growth: Competitive salary aligned with your experience level.



Flexibility: 100% remote work environment.



Impact: High level of ownership and technical influence over a mission-critical platform.



Culture: A collaborative team with high engineering standards and no "red tape."



How to Apply

If you are a dedicated developer looking for a long-term role where your contributions truly matter, please apply with your updated resume and a brief summary of your experience with Java/Angular architectures.

title: Mortgage Operations Assistant
description:
MINDFUL LENDING

Loan Partner — Mortgage Operations Assistant



About This Role

We are a US-based mortgage brokerage in California helping move-up homebuyers across 12 states gain mastery in homeownership. Our work is detail-heavy, document-heavy, and deadline-driven. We are looking for one full-time Loan Partner to join our team and own the document collection, file organization, and conditions tracking work that keeps our pipeline moving.

This is not a generic VA role. You will be working inside live mortgage files — for W2 borrowers, self-employed borrowers, and Non-QM scenarios — and your accuracy directly affects whether families close on time.

If you have 2+ years processing experience in the broker channel and you take pride in being the most organized person on the team, we want to hear from you.



Hard Requirements (Apply Only If You Meet ALL of These)

Experience

2+ years of mortgage loan processing experience in the broker channel (not retail, not banking)

Hands-on experience with W2 borrower documentation

Tools (Familiarity Preferred)

References

Each reference must include name, phone number, and

References must be from supervisors or loan officers you directly supported, not coworkers



EXCEPTION: If you have been continuously employed with a single employer for more than 24 months, ONE reference from that employer is acceptable. Two references from different employers is still preferred where possible.

Availability and Commitment (Non-Negotiable)

You must be able to start within 7 calendar days of accepting the offer. If your timeline is longer than 7 days, this role is not a fit.

This role is exclusive and full-time. You will not work for any other Loan Officer, mortgage broker, real estate professional, or US-based client during your employment with Mindful Lending. No side gigs, no part-time clients, no exceptions.

Candidates currently available to start immediately — including those recently laid off or between roles — are strongly encouraged to apply.



By applying, you confirm that if hired, Mindful Lending will be your sole employer and your full professional focus.

If you do not meet all the requirements above, please do not apply. We will verify everything.



Schedule and Work Hours

Core Hours: 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM PST, Monday – Friday

Manila equivalent: 12:00 AM – 8:00 AM PHT (midnight to 8 AM)

This is a night shift in the Philippines. You must be able to commit to this schedule consistently. If you have caregiving obligations, a second job, or sleep patterns that conflict with overnight work, this role is not a fit.

During the first 90 days:

On Zoom with camera on for the full PST window

Continuously monitoring Zoom and available immediately for team support throughout the day

Flexibility is a core skill — priorities shift, urgent files come up, and you respond

No exceptions on the camera-on policy except for breaks



Break Structure (Unpaid):

You choose one of two break options each day, declared at the morning meeting so the team knows when you are off:

Option A: One full hour, taken between 12:00 and 1:00 PM PST

Option B: Two 30-minute breaks — one between 11:30 AM and 12:30 PM PST, one between 2:30 and 3:30 PM PST

Camera off, no Zoom required during breaks. Breaks are unpaid. You are responsible for accurately logging which option you took each day on your activity log.



After 90 days (performance-based):

This early start is a privilege earned through proactive performance, not a default



Daily Schedule:

The schedule below is an example of how a typical day flows. Actual daily tasks and timing will vary based on pipeline activity, urgent files, and team priorities. You will be given clear, specific instructions on what to execute each day — clarity is a core value of how we operate, and you will never be left guessing what is expected.

 follow-ups.

What You Will Own

1. Document Collection and Follow-Up

This is your daily core work. Every active file gets reviewed every morning. Missing documents get followed up on the same day, every day, until they are received.

For W2 Clients, you will collect:

2 most recent months of bank statements

For every property owned: mortgage statements, homeowner's insurance, property tax bill, HOA statements, solar lease or PPA agreements

3. Pre-Approval File Prep

Before any file is handed off for pre-approval analysis, you confirm:

Income docs collected and verified

Basic completeness check passed

All pre-approval related docs collected

Then you notify the Operations Manager that the file is ready for analysis.



4. Conditions Tracking

You maintain the conditions tracker (Google Sheet or CRM) and update it daily. Every condition has one of three statuses: Pending, Requested, or Received. The Operations Manager reviews conditions and tells you what to collect. You request, track, and follow up.



Reporting Structure and Communication

Reports to: Operations Manager (Pre-Underwriter)

Communication tools: Zoom (live presence and meetings),
 (client and lender comms), WhatsApp (internal team and urgent client touch)

Internal response time during work hours: Within 2 minutes — Zoom is monitored continuously and you are available immediately for support

Flexibility: Priorities shift throughout the day. Adapting quickly to new urgent files and changing requests is a core skill of this role, not an exception.



How Performance Is Measured

We measure work, not effort. You will know exactly where you stand at the end of every day, every week, and at day 90.

90-Day Evaluation (gate to wage increase and continued employment):

At day 90, you must hit all six of these to continue and receive the wage increase:

Average doc collection cycle time ? 7 days across all files handled

Pre-approval handoff rework rate ? 10%

Zero missed conditions deadlines that caused a closing delay

100% on-camera attendance during scheduled hours (lunch excluded)

Two unsolicited positive client mentions OR one positive realtor-partner mention



Compensation and Career Growth

This is a long-term position with a defined wage progression. We are looking for someone we can grow with for years, not months. Your earnings increase as your skills, ownership, and contribution to the team expand.

Note: The metrics referenced below are examples of what we have seen drive success in this role historically. Actual performance expectations may differ. Specific, written metrics of success will be confirmed and provided to you prior to your start date, so you know exactly what you are working toward from day one.

Tier 1 — Starting Rate: $7.50 USD per hour

Days 1 through 90. The ramp and trial period. You are learning our systems, our team, and our standards while contributing on every active file.

Tier 2 — Established Rate: $8.00 USD per hour

Granted upon successful completion of the 90-day evaluation (criteria listed above in the Performance section). This is the "you have proven you can do the job consistently" raise. From day 91 forward.

Tier 3 — Senior Loan Partner Rate: $9.00 USD per hour

Earned through demonstrating skills beyond core processing — leadership, ownership, and process improvement. To reach Tier 3, you must hit ALL of the following for two consecutive months:



Full pipeline ownership: Manages 100% of conditions, submissions, and pipeline updates for the active 3–5 loan pipeline without prompting

Zero missing docs at handoff: When a file is passed off for pre-approval, it greenlights from the Operations Manager on the first review — no missing docs, no rework

? 90% of files passed to Operations Manager rated "Green" on the internal file status tracker (Green = complete on first pass; Yellow = minor items missing; Red = sent back for rework)

Has received at least one positive feedback via text,
, or verbal communication from a realtor partner, transaction coordinator, or title tea
mber — conveyed to the Loan Officer

Typical time to reach Tier 3: 6 to 12 months for a strong hire. This is not automatic — it is earned by demonstrating you have grown into more than the starting role.



Other Terms

Hours: Full-time, 35 paid hours per week (9am–5pm PST with 1 hour unpaid break)

Pay cycle: Every two weeks

Payroll process: You submit a bi-weekly invoice with a daily activity log. Each day's entry must include start time, end time, break option taken (1 hour OR two 30-min blocks), total paid hours, and a brief activity summary. Template provided.

Approximate monthly earnings (full-time): $1,137 USD at Tier 1, $1,213 at Tier 2, $1,365 at Tier 3

A Final Note

Mindful Lending is built on four values: compassion, selflessness, courage, and integrity. We treat our team the way we treat our clients — with respect, clarity, and a real commitment to your growth.  automations and workflows

 campaigns

title: GoHighLevel + Meta Ads Specialist
description:
hi! I’m a licensed therapist in Canada, and I created an international course and community called The Befriending Your Parts Framework to help deep feelers heal shame, soften their Inner Critic, regulate their nervous system, and come out of Survival Mode.



A big part of my audience struggles with trust, self-worth, vulnerability, and feeling emotionally safe with others.



Because of this, relational marketing matters deeply in my business.



I’m not interested in aggressive marketing tactics or “hypey” ads. My audience needs to feel:



-safe

-understood

-connected

-and genuinely supported



And that trust-building piece is incredibly important to me.



???? WHAT I’M LOOKING FOR



I’m looking for someone with:



at least 3+ years experience in BOTH GoHighLevel and Meta Ads

strong technical skills

excellent problem-solving ability

high attention to detail

and someone who enjoys collaboration and wants to grow with a meaningful business long-term



I genuinely enjoy:



-creating content ideas

-writing copy

-developing creatives

-understanding the strategy behind what’s working



So I’m looking for someone who can bring strong technical + strategic support while still collaborating closely with me throughout the process.



 GOHIGHLEVEL RESPONSIBILITIES

You would help with:



-Funnels + Systems

-Building and editing funnels

-Creating opt-in pages, webinar funnels, sales funnels, checkout pages, and thank-you pages

-Setting up and troubleshooting workflows + automations

-Managing CRM organization

-Tags, pipelines, segmentation, workflows, triggers, etc.

-Course and membership support

-Troubleshooting technical issues

-Problem solving when systems break or aren’t converting properly

-Tracking + Data

-Setting up tracking correctly across funnels and Meta Ads

-Pixel setup

-Conversion tracking

-UTM tracking

-Event tracking

-Helping ensure accurate data across Meta + GHL

-Monitoring leads and conversions

-Updating and tracking data inside Google Sheets so we can make informed decisions based on numbers



 META ADS RESPONSIBILITIES

I do have some experience running Meta Ads myself, and I’ve invested in learning over the years.

I actually haven’t run ads consistently for the last 7 months because my business has been growing well organically through Instagram.



But now I’m ready to start running ads again and want strong support.



You would help with:

=Setting up ad campaigns

=Testing ad sets

=Monitoring performance

=Tracking and interpreting data

=Helping optimize campaigns

=Retargeting setup

=Funnel performance analysis

=Helping identify what’s working and what needs adjusting

=Collaborating on strategy and creative direction

=I have a business coach, Rachel McMichael, and she has an ads course/training that I would like the person working with me to go through so we’re aligned in strategy, language, and approach.





RELATIONAL MARKETING MATTERS

This is really important to me.



My audience is made up of people healing shame, trauma, self-esteem wounds, and nervous system dysregulation.



Trust is harder for many of them.

So the marketing has to feel:

-human

-relational

-emotionally safe

-authentic

-grounded



That matters just as much to me as the technical side.



 LEAD SUPPORT

I’m also looking for support with:

-tracking warm leads

-organizing leads inside Google Sheets and/or CRM

-helping with gentle follow-up and outreach to warm leads when appropriate



BONUS SKILLS (not required, but welcomed)

-Canva experience

-Video editing

-Social media support

-Creative eye for branding/design


 marketing experience

-Launch support experience



DETAILS

Starting at approximately 5–10 hours/week

Opportunity for growth over time

Remote + flexible hours

Looking for a long-term fit

TO APPLY



Please send:

Your experience with BOTH GHL + Meta Ads

Examples of funnels and systems you’ve built

Examples of ad campaigns you’ve managed

Any tracking/data experience

Any creative skills (Canva, video editing, etc.)

A short note on why this role feels like a fit for you



Thank you so much ????

title: Construction Bookkeeper
description:
JOB RESPONSIBILITIES INCLUDE BUT ARE NOT LIMITED TO:



1. Core Construction Accounting

*Maintain accurate job cost accounting across all active projects

*Prepare and manage Work-in-Progress (WIP) schedules, including revenue recognition and cost tracking

*Track retainage, committed costs, and budget vs. actual performance

*Ensure alignment between Procore (or PM systems) and Sage 300

*Support job “buyout” tracking and subcontractor financial coordination



2. Cash Flow & Financial Visibility (CRITICAL FOCUS)

*Develop and maintain cash flow projections at both company and project levels

*Provide leadership with clear, timely insight into cash position and future needs

*Assist in identifying risks related to margin erosion, cost overruns, or delayed collections

*Partner with leadership and fractional CFO/Controller to improve financial forecasting

*This directly addresses current gaps where high-level financial oversight and cash flow clarity are needed.



3. Accounts Payable & Subcontractor Management

*Manage AP workflows including vendor invoices, approvals, and payments

*Oversee subcontractor compliance (lien waivers, insurance, documentation)

*Coordinate payments tied to project funding and draw schedules

*Resolve discrepancies with vendors and internal teams



4. Month-End Close & Reporting

*Execute month-end close processes, including:

**Journal entries

**Bank and credit card reconciliations

**Job cost reconciliation

*Prepare and deliver:

**WIP reports

**Cash flow reports

**AP/AR aging

**Job profitability summaries

*Ensure reporting is accurate, timely, and actionable for leadership



5. Systems & Process Improvement

*Identify inefficiencies and implement improvements in:

**Accounting workflows

**Data accuracy between systems (Sage, Procore, etc.)

*Help establish repeatable processes and reporting frameworks

*Support implementation of automation and AI tools where applicable

*Aligns with company interest in improving systems and integrating AI into operations.



6. Collaboration with Operations & Leadership

*Act as a financial partner to:

**Operations (project execution, buyouts, cost control)

**Estimating (historical cost data, accuracy)

*Support leadership in protecting margins and making informed decisions

*Participate in regular reporting cadence (weekly/monthly financial updates)



7. Team Support & Continuity

*Provide support and backup for existing accounting personnel

*Help document processes to reduce dependency on any single tea
mber

*Assist in onboarding and training additional accounting support (including offshore resources if applicable)

*Important due to current reliance on key personnel and need for redundancy.



SUCCESS METRICS (KPIs)

*Accuracy and timeliness of WIP reporting

*Visibility and reliability of cash flow forecasts

*Reduction in accounting-related project issues (billing, cost tracking, etc.)

*Improved alignment between accounting and operations

*Consistency in monthly close timelines

*Reduction in leadership intervention needed for financial clarity



EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS REQUIRED:

*Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.

*Active CPA license preferred.

*Minimum 5 years of progressive experience in accounting, with at least 2 years in the construction industry.

*Expertise in public accounting, specifically serving construction clients and managing multiple client accounts.

*Strong proficiency in accounting systems (e.g., Sage300, Timberscan) and project management tools (e.g., ProCore) is highly preferred

*Deep understanding of construction accounting standards, including WIP reporting, retainage, and cost allocation.

*Passion for delivering exceptional client service and fostering lasting client relationships.

*Excellent organizational and time-management skills to balance multiple client priorities.

*Strong leadership and team development capabilities.

*Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.

*High attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.

*Ability to communicate complex financial concepts to non-financial stakeholders.



Tech Requirements:

*Computer - at least i5 or equivalent with 8gb RAM

*Internet Speed - At least 50 MBPS Download speed



Job Type: Part-time

Schedule: Monday to Friday 8:30 AM – 12:30 PM CDT - Monday to Friday 9:30 PM to 1:30 AM PHT

Salary Range: Php 40,000 - Php 55,000 monthly, Depending on experience

After submitting the form, click the apply button and send us a short message on why you would be a good fit for the role.

title: Lumber takeoff specialist
description:
We are a multifamily wood framing subcontractor based in Texas.  We bid and build 3 to 5 story wood-framed apartment projects in Houston, DFW, Austin, and San Antonio.



We are looking for a remote lumber takeoff specialist to help support our estimating team.



The Work



You will pull lumber takeoffs from architectural and structural PDF plan sets.  Plan sets are usually 200 to 400 pages.



Typical takeoff items include:



• Studs

• Plates

• Headers

• Beams

title: SOC Analyst (Level 1–2)
description:
Position Summary

We are seeking a SOC Analyst (Level 1–2) to join our Security Operations team. In this role, you will be responsible for triaging security alerts, conducting in-depth investigations, performing root cause analysis (RCA), and recommending or executing remediation steps. You'll work across a modern security stack including Microsoft Sentinel, Defender, FortiGate, Netskope, ObserveIT, Auvik, and NinjaRMM - and you'll leverage AI-assisted analysis tools (including Claude) to accelerate investigation and response.



This is a hands-on, technically rigorous role for someone who thrives on solving puzzles, communicating clearly under pressure, and constantly leveling up their security craft.



Key Responsibilities



Alert Triage & Monitoring

Monitor security alerts and events across Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Defender (Endpoint, Identity, Cloud Apps, Office 365), Netskope, FortiGate firewalls, ObserveIT, Auvik, and NinjaRMM.

Perform initial triage of incoming alerts: validate fidelity, classify severity, assign priority, and determine whether an alert is a true positive, false positive, or benign true positive.

Acknowledge, document, and escalate alerts per defined SLAs and runbooks.

Maintain situational awareness across multiple client environments, tenants, and Azure stack workloads (AVD, Azure VMs, Azure AD/Entra ID, Azure networking).



Investigation & Root Cause Analysis

Conduct detailed investigations into security i
 — pivoting across logs, endpoint telemetry, network flows, identity signals, and user activity to build a full picture of what happened.

Construct timelines of events, identify the initial access vector, lateral movement, and impact.

Perform root cause analysis (RCA) to determine the underlying conditions that allowed an i
 to occur (misconfiguration, missing control, user behavior, vulnerability, etc.).

Use Microsoft Sentinel KQL queries to hunt across log sources, build investigations, and validate hypotheses.

Leverage AI-assisted tools (including Claude) to accelerate log analysis, summarize findings, draft queries, and support investigation workflows - while maintaining analyst judgment and validation.



Response & Next Steps

Recommend and, where authorized, execute containment and remediation actions (isolating endpoints, disabling accounts, blocking IOCs at the firewall or proxy, revoking sessions, etc.).

Coordinate with Tier 3 / IR specialists and client-facing teams to hand off complex i
 with complete context.

Document clear, actionable next steps for clients — including technical remediation, policy changes, user education, and follow-up validation.

Produce concise, professional i
 write-ups suitable for both technical and non-technical client audiences.



Continuous Improvement

Tune detection rules and analytics in Sentinel and Defender to reduce false positives and improve signal quality.

Contribute to and maintain SOC runbooks, playbooks, and standard operating procedures.

Identify recurring i
 patterns and recommend systemic improvements (control gaps, configuration drift, training opportunities).

Stay current on threat intelligence, emerging TTPs, and vulnerabilities relevant to client environments.



Required Qualifications

Experience: 1–3+ years in a SOC, NOC with security responsibilities, MSP/MSSP, IT security, or similar hands-on role.

SIEM: Hands-on experience with Microsoft Sentinel, including writing and tuning KQL queries.

Microsoft Security Stack: Working knowledge of Microsoft Defender (Endpoint, Identity, Cloud Apps, O365) and Azure AD / Entra ID.

Azure: Familiarity with Azure stack components — Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD), Azure VMs, Azure networking, and core IAM concepts.

Network Security: Practical experience reading FortiGate firewall logs, policies, and traffic flows.

Endpoint & Cloud Tools: Exposure to Netskope (SWG/CASB), ObserveIT (or similar UAM/insider risk), NinjaRMM (or comparable RMM), and Auvik (or comparable network monitoring).

Investigation Skills: Demonstrated ability to perform structured triage, root cause analysis, and produce clear i
 documentation.

Foundations: Solid grasp of TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP(S), authentication protocols, common attack techniques (MITRE ATT&CK), and Windows event logs.

Communication: Strong written and verbal communication — able to explain technical findings to non-technical stakeholders.

Mindset: Curiosity, attention to detail, and the discipline to follow process without losing the ability to think critically.



Preferred Qualifications

Industry certifications such as Security+, AZ-500, SC-200, SC-900, CySA+, GCIA, GCIH, or equivalent.

Experience in an MSP or MSSP environment supporting multiple client tenants.

Scripting / automation experience (PowerShell, Python, KQL functions, Logic Apps, Sentinel playbooks).

Experience integrating or working with AI-assisted security tooling (e.g., Claude, Security Copilot) for investigation and reporting workflows.

Exposure to threat intelligence platforms, EDR forensic workflows, and basic malware triage.

Familiarity with compliance frameworks (NIST CSF, CIS, HIPAA, SOC 2).



What You'll Get

title: Customer Service Specialist
description:
**Senior Customer Service Specialist Wanted — Fashion Dropshipping (UK/US Markets)**



We are a growing fashion dropshipping company running multiple Shopify stores targeting the UK and other English-speaking markets. We are looking for an experienced Customer Service Specialist who can fully take ownership of our entire customer service operation and bring it to the next level.



**About the role:**



You will be the person fully responsible for our customer service. We will share with you all the knowledge and SOPs we've built up over the past 2 years, and combined with your own experience and expertise, your job is to make sure our customer service operates at a high level. Your number one goal is to keep our refund rate under 5% and our chargeback rate as low as possible. The way you frame solutions, communicate with customers, and handle complaints directly determines the financial health of this business.



You will also be in charge of communicating with the rest of the team, including our supplier side and our dispute manager, to make sure issues are resolved quickly and efficiently.



**What you will be doing:**



- Take full ownership of our customer service across multiple Shopify stores

- Handle around 20
 tickets per hour at a high quality level

- Handle escalated tickets including damaged items, chargeback threats, delivered but not received cases, wrong items, refund disputes, and angry customer situations

- Communicate proactively with our supplier on delays, damaged goods, and quality issues

- Communicate closely with our dispute manager to ensure chargebacks and disputes are handled with the right information from the customer side

- Communicate with last mile carriers to resolve delivery issues

- Train and oversee junior team members

- Maintain and improve our SOPs and customer service templates

- Provide daily and weekly reporting to management

- Identify patterns in complaints and feedback into product/supplier decisions



**To confirm you've read this post carefully, please start your application with the word "Pineapple". Applications without this word will not be considered.**



**What we are looking for:**



- Minimum 2+ years of experience in customer service, specifically within fashion dropshipping or fashion ecommerce

- Proven track record of keeping refund rates and chargeback rates low

- Strong experience with Shopify Admin (orders, refunds, fulfilment, customer profiles)

- Strong experience with Reamaze (this is the platform we use daily)

- Solid knowledge of last mile carrier issues and how to resolve them (failed deliveries, parcel pickup, return to sender, info received delays, etc.)

- Experience with chargeback prevention tools like Disputifier is a plus, but not required — our dispute manager handles this side, although close communication with them is essential

- Strong experience working with Chinese suppliers in a dropshipping setup

- Able to handle approximately 20 well-written
 tickets per hour without compromising quality

- Strong written and spoken English (native level or very close to it)

- Excellent communication and de-escalation skills

- Ability to work independently and take ownership without needing micromanagement

- A genuinely warm, empathetic personality — customers should FEEL that they are talking to a real human who cares



**Mindset we are looking for:**



- Solution-oriented — you always look for a way to make the customer happy without hurting the business

- Data-driven — you track your own KPIs and look for ways to improve them

- Calm under pressure — angry customers and disputes don't shake you

- Long-term thinker — you understand that every customer interaction either builds or damages our brand

- Detail-oriented — you don't miss the small things that escalate into chargebacks

- A strong communicator — you keep the dispute manager and the rest of the team in the loop without being asked



**What we offer:**



- Long-term collaboration with growth potential

- Competitive compensation based on experience

- The opportunity to fully own and shape an entire department

- Working with multiple growing fashion brands

- Freedom to work from home

- Performance-based bonuses tied to refund and chargeback rate improvements



**How to apply:**



Please include in your application:



1. Your experience in fashion dropshipping customer service (which companies, what period, what was your role)

2. The lowest refund rate and chargeback rate you've personally managed to achieve, and how

3. Your experience with Shopify and Reamaze specifically

4. Examples of last mile carrier issues you've solved in the past

5. Your experience working with Chinese suppliers in a dropshipping setup

6. Roughly how many tickets per hour you're comfortable handling at a high quality level

7. Your availability and expected compensation



We look forward to hearing from you!

Shipping & Receiving: Acts as the primary point of contact for Shipping & Receiving issues. Coordinates with suppliers and the prep center to resolve tracking discrepancies and receiving log errors.



Inventory Reconciliation: Conducts full monthly inventory ledger reconciliations (Units Shipped vs. Received vs. Sold) to locate capital leakage.



Account Health & Recovery: Daily audit of the account health dashboard. Coordinates with account health and reimbursement companies to resolve IP complaints, authenticity flags, and lost/damaged stock claims.



Return Monitoring: Perform a daily audit of "Returns Received" reports in Seller Central.



Reason Assessment: Categorize every return (e.g., "Defective," "Wrong Item Sent," "Customer Damaged," or "Item Not as Described").

If "Defective/Damaged": Evaluate if the issue is with the product quality or the prep center's packaging.

If "Item Not as Described/Wrong Item": Verify if the Sourcing VA incorrectly verified the UPC/Product packaging.

Corrective Action Loop: Immediately report high-frequency "Defective" items to the Purchasing Agent to blacklist the supplier/ASIN from future buying.



Monthly Reconciliation: You are required to perform a full monthly inventory ledger reconciliation by pulling the Inventory Ledger Summary Report from Seller Central.



Cross-Verification: Compare this report against your physical inventory arrival logs (from Prep Center) and sales data (Units Shipped vs. Units Sold vs. Damaged/Lost) to identify discrepancies.



Leakage Identification: Document any units that appear in Seller Central records as "missing" or "unaccounted for" and generate detailed documentation case files to initiate a capital recovery process with Gladys and Amazon support.



Quarterly Audit: Conduct a deep-dive macro audit every quarter, tracing long-term warehouse changes, historical shipment adjustments, and cargo logs to permanently block recurring inventory leaks.



Profitability Auditing: Cross-reference active inventory to ensure strict adherence to the 30% ROI and $4.00 net profit floor, and track reimbursements for lost FBA stock.



Aged Inventory Management: Identify "dead stock" (90+ days) or tanked ASINs and execute strategic removal orders to route unviable inventory for liquidation.



eBay Listing & Liquidation: Liquidate returns and aged inventory from Amazon on ebay. Create and manage listings, competitive pricing, and Multi-Channel Fulfillment (MCF) on our eBay storefront to maximize capital $ recovery.
