title: GUEST COMMUNICATION & AI OPERATIONS ASSOCIATE
description:
ABOUT OODA



OODA Management is a San Diego-based short-term rental property management company building the next generation of how short-term rentals are run.



Short-term rental management is hard to scale. Every property is different, every guest is different, and every situation requires judgment. Most companies either deliver great personalized service at small scale, or they grow and the service quality quietly falls apart.



We are building the company that does not make that trade.



We are small and AI-native by design. We use AI tools, automation, and tight operating systems to deliver service at a level legacy property managers cannot match without hiring far more people.



Guest communication is one of the most important parts of that system.



This role starts with guest messaging, but the long-term opportunity is helping us build the guest communication engine of an AI-native property management company.



ABOUT THE ROLE



This is a guest communication role with an AI operations growth path.



Your first responsibility is simple and important: make sure guests receive fast, clear, calm, professional support.



You will respond to guest messages, follow SOPs, escalate issues, update internal systems, and help ensure guests feel taken care of during their stay.



But this is not just a message-answering job.



At OODA, every guest message is also a signal.



A guest asks a confusing check-in question. Why was it confusing?

A guest reports an issue late at night. What information do we need?

A guest asks the same thing five other guests asked. Should we update the template?

A situation keeps repeating. Should AI handle it next time?

A message could have been prevented. What was missing from the instructions?



We are looking for someone who can handle the guest professionally today, then help us make the system better tomorrow.



You do not need to be a programmer.



You do not need to have a deep technical background.



But you should be comfortable with software, interested in AI tools, and excited to learn how automation can improve operations.



WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS



Most guest messaging jobs are simple: answer questions, follow scripts, close tickets.



This is different.



OODA is building a system where human judgment and AI work together. Guest communication is one of the main places where that happens.



The person in this role will help us understand:



What guests ask most often

Which messages require human judgment

Which messages can eventually be automated

Where our instructions are confusing

Where our SOPs need improvement

Where AI responses are helpful

Where AI responses need correction

What information the team needs to make better decisions



This role is for someone who wants to become excellent at guest communication and then help us build a smarter system around it.



The starting point is guest support.



The growth path is ownership.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



Your work may include:



Responding to guest messages across Airbnb, property management tools,
, SMS, and other channels

Answering questions about check-in, checkout, WiFi, parking, amenities, house rules, and property details

Helping guests with access issues, unclear instructions, maintenance concerns, cleaning issues, and other stay-related problems

Following SOPs and message templates while still sounding natural and human

Keeping every conversation calm, clear, and professional

Updating internal systems so the team knows what is happening

Escalating maintenance, cleaning, access, or guest experience issues correctly

Tracking repeated guest questions and recurring problems

Helping improve message templates, SOPs, and internal notes

Using AI tools like ChatGPT to draft, summarize, classify, and improve communication

Reviewing AI-generated messages for accuracy, tone, and guest experience

Helping identify which guest questions can be safely automated

Helping train and refine AI-assisted guest communication over time



You will not be expected to build software.



But you should be excited to work inside a company where the goal is to make the system better every week.



THE BIGGER OPPORTUNITY



This role starts at 10 to 25 hours per week.



We are starting part-time intentionally. The first phase is about learning our properties, tools, guest standards, SOPs, and escalation rules.



For the right person, this can become full-time after the initial period.



As OODA grows, the guest communication function will need people who can own more responsibility. That may mean expanded hours, team leadership, quality assurance, SOP ownership, AI training, guest messaging management, or a more specialized AI operations role.



The best people in this function will not just answer messages.



They will help define how guest communication should work.



That means:



Better guest templates

Better escalation rules

Better AI prompts

Better training examples

Better quality control

Better reporting

Better internal notes

Better workflows between guests, vendors, cleaners, and the operations team



We are looking for someone who wants to grow with the function, not just complete a shift.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



We are looking for someone who is:



COMMUNICATION

Excellent in written English

Strong spoken English preferred

Clear, calm, warm, and professional

Able to write naturally, not robotically

Able to communicate with guests who are tired, confused, frustrated, or in a hurry

Able to follow templates without sounding like a script

TEMPERAMENT

Calm under pressure

Reliable during the agreed schedule

Detail-oriented

Patient with guests

Comfortable handling multiple conversations at once

Able to work independently during overnight coverage

Hungry for more responsibility over time

JUDGMENT

Knows when to solve and when to escalate

Does not overpromise

Does not ignore details

Can follow SOPs carefully

Notices patterns in repeated guest issues

Thinks in root causes, not just one-off replies

Can be trusted with guest-facing communication

SYSTEMS AND AI

Comfortable learning new software tools

Comfortable using ChatGPT or willing to learn quickly

Interested in AI, automation, systems, or process improvement

Able to review AI-generated messages and d
 whether they are accurate and appropriate

Excited by the idea of helping train AI-assisted guest communication over time



You do not need to be a developer.



But you should be the kind of person who says:



“I answered the guest correctly, but why did they need to ask this in the first place?”



That mindset matters.



THIS ROLE IS A STRONG FIT IF YOU

Have experience in guest messaging, customer support, hospitality, virtual assistance, or operations

Have supported U.S.-based customers or guests before

Can write excellent English without sounding robotic

Are comfortable working U.S. Pacific Time hours

Can handle multiple chats or messages at once

Stay calm when guests are upset or confused

Like improving templates, SOPs, and processes

Are interested in AI tools and automation

Want to grow into a larger role over time

Are based in the Philippines and comfortable working remotely



Bonus points if you have experience with:



Airbnb

Hospitable

Guesty

OwnerRez

Hostaway

Slack

ClickUp

Notion

Google Sheets

ChatGPT or other AI tools

Short-term rental operations

Customer support QA

SOP creation

Process improvement

Guest messaging management

Night shift or overnight support

THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR YOU IF



Please do not apply if:



Your written English is weak

You only want a basic VA task list

You dislike following processes

You get flustered when guests are upset

You do not want to learn new tools

You are not interested in AI, systems, or process improvement

You want a role where you only do what you are told and never think critically

You cannot work reliably during the agreed schedule

You are uncomfortable being measured on quality, reliability, and improvement



We are not looking for someone who just “handles messages.”



We are looking for someone who wants to master guest communication and help us build a better operating system around it.



THE QUALITY BAR



Because written English is the core of this job, here is the standard.



You should be able to write messages like these naturally:



“Hi Sarah, thanks for reaching out. I’m sorry about the confusion. Let me check this for you right now and I’ll follow up shortly.”



“You’re all set. The cleaner confirmed the item was found, and we’ll coordinate the best way to get it back to you.”



“I understand how frustrating that must be. I’ve escalated this to our maintenance team and will keep you updated as soon as I hear back.”



Clear. Calm. Human. Accurate.



That is the bar.



WHAT GREAT LOOKS LIKE

BY 30 DAYS

You understand our properties, tools, SOPs, and guest communication standards

You can handle routine guest messages with limited help

Your written replies are consistently clear, warm, and professional

You escalate the right issues to the right people

You are dependable during your assigned schedule

BY 90 DAYS

You can independently handle most guest messaging situations

Your judgment is reliable enough that the operations team trusts your decisions

You have identified recurring guest questions or workflow problems

You have suggested improvements to templates, SOPs, or escalation rules

You are using AI tools to improve speed and quality

BY 180 DAYS

You are not just running the workflow, you are improving it

You have helped implement concrete improvements to guest communication

You are contributing examples, feedback, and ideas that improve AI-assisted operations

You are becoming a true owner inside the guest communication function, not just a message responder

EXAMPLE OF THE MINDSET WE WANT



A normal guest messaging person says:



“The guest asked for the WiFi, so I sent the WiFi.”



A great person in this role says:



“The guest asked for the WiFi, so I sent it. But this is the fifth time guests have asked this property for WiFi this month, so maybe the check-in instructions are unclear. I recommend adding WiFi to the first arrival message.”



That is the difference.



A normal guest messaging person says:



“The guest said the door code did not work, so I escalated it.”



A great person in this role says:



“The guest said the door code did not work, so I escalated it. But I also checked whether the code was sent correctly, whether the guest was at the correct door, and whether this has happened before at this property.”



That is what we are looking for.



SCHEDULE AND GROWTH PATH



This role starts at 10 to 25 hours per week.



Coverage during U.S. Pacific Time hours is required. Overnight guest support is part of this role.



We are starting part-time intentionally. The first phase is about learning the business, proving reliability, showing strong judgment, and demonstrating that you can handle guest communication with increasing independence.



For the right person, this can become a full-time role after the initial period.



As OODA grows, we want to build long-term roles around the people who prove they can own real parts of the operation. That may mean expanded hours, full-time contractor work, a formal employment role, quality assurance ownership, team leadership, or a more specialized AI operations position.



This is not a short-term task list.



It is an entry point into the operating team of a company being built for scale.



WHEN YOU MESSAGE US



When you message us, please briefly tell us:



Your guest messaging, customer support, hospitality, VA, or operations experience

Your availability in U.S. Pacific Time

Your desired hourly rate

What tools you have used before

Whether you have used ChatGPT or other AI tools

Why this role interests you beyond basic guest messaging



Also include the word PINEAPPLE at the top of your message so we know you read the full post.

title: Full-Time Executive & Family Assistant for Golf Business Owner
description:
We are looking for a full-time Family Executive Assistant to help with business, personal, and family-related tasks.



This is not a basic VA role.



We are looking for someone highly organized, proactive, detail-oriented, trustworthy, and comfortable using AI to improve how they work.



I run a golf coaching business based in the United States, and my family also spends time between the United States and Australia. This role will support both business operations and family logistics.



The right person will help take tasks off my plate, keep things organized, follow up on details, and make sure nothing falls through the cracks.



About the Role



This role includes a mix of:



* Executive assistant work

* Family assistant work

* Personal admin

* Business admin

* Travel planning

* Research

* Scheduling

* Follow-up

* Documentation

* AI-enabled systems and organization



We need someone who can take messy information and turn it into something clear, organized, and useful.



Business Support



You may help with:



* Managing
 inboxes

* Prioritizing important messages

* Drafting replies using clear instructions and templates

* Responding to basic customer inquiries

* Organizing leads, clients, and follow-ups

* Updating Google Sheets, documents, and internal trackers

* Scheduling calls, lessons, meetings, and reminders

* Creating SOPs, checklists, and process documents

* Following up with contractors, tea
mbers, students, and vendors

* Organizing files, links, documents, and business resources

* Helping with basic business research

* Supporting tools like Gmail, Google Calendar, Google Sheets, HubSpot, Kajabi, Circle, CoachNow, Stripe, or similar platforms



Family & Personal Support



You may help with:



* Organizing family travel between the United States, Australia, and other locations

* Researching flights, hotels, transportation, visa requirements, and travel options

* Building clear travel itineraries

* Comparing travel options in simple summaries

* Tracking important family dates, appointments, bookings, and reminders

* Helping organize personal documents and family schedules

* Researching services, products, appointments, or vendors

* Helping keep household and family admin organized

* Making sure logistics are handled before they become stressful



AI-Enabled Operations



This is very important.



We are looking for someone who actively uses AI to improve how they work.



This does not mean simply using ChatGPT to write
s.



We want someone who can use AI to:



* Organize messy information

* Summarize
s, documents, and conversations

* Create checklists and SOPs

* Research and compare options

* Build repeatable workflows

* Improve follow-up

* Reduce mistakes

* Save time

* Turn repeated tasks into better systems



The right person should be able to look at a task and think:



* How can this be done faster next time?

* How can this become a checklist or SOP?

* How can AI help organize the information?

* How can AI help reduce missed details?

* How can this become less dependent on me?



You do not need to be a developer.



But you do need to be resourceful, curious, and comfortable using AI as a serious productivity tool, not just a writing assistant.



Good Examples of AI Use



Good examples would include:



* Turning a messy
 thread into a clear action list

* Summarizing travel options into a comparison table

* Creating an SOP from a repeated task

* Building a checklist for future use

* Organizing meeting notes into next steps

* Creating a follow-up tracker

* Researching options and presenting the best choices clearly

* Finding a way to make a repeated admin process faster next time



Bad examples would be:



* “I use ChatGPT to write
s”

* “I ask AI for ideas”

* “I copy and paste things into ChatGPT”



That is not enough for this role.



Requirements



You must be:



* Excellent in written English

* Highly organized

* Detail-oriented

* Reliable

* Proactive

* Trustworthy with private information

* Good at following instructions

* Good at asking smart questions when something is unclear

* Comfortable working independently

* Comfortable doing research

* Comfortable using AI tools to improve your work

* Comfortable with both business and family/personal tasks

* Comfortable with Google Docs, Google Sheets, Gmail, Google Calendar, and common online tools



Work Schedule



This is a full-time role.



You must be available to work the schedule we set for the role.



Some overlap with US Central Time is required. The schedule may change depending on business and family needs.



Please do not apply if you are only looking for flexible hours or if you cannot work during the required schedule.



Pay



Please include your expected monthly salary in USD.



We are looking for the right long-term person, so there is room to grow in responsibility over time.



Who This Is For



This role is for someone who enjoys bringing order to chaos.



You should like organizing details, creating systems, checking things off, following up, and helping busy people stay on track.



You should be comfortable handling both business tasks and family logistics.



You should not need every single step explained forever. We will provide direction and training, but over time, we want someone who can take ownership and improve how things are done.



Who This Is Not For



This is not a good fit if:



* You only want basic task work

* You wait for every single instruction

* You are not comfortable using AI

* You only use AI for writing basic
s

* You dislike organizing details

* You struggle with follow-up

* You miss deadlines

* You are uncomfortable handling both business and personal tasks

* You do not like building checklists, systems, or repeatable processes



How to Apply



Use this exact subject line when applying:



SYSTEMS



Applications that do not include SYSTEMS in the subject line will not be reviewed.



In your application, answer these questions:



1. Why do you think you are a good fit for this role?

2. What experience do you have as a VA, executive assistant, personal assistant, family assistant, or admin assistant?

3. Have you helped with travel planning before? Give a specific example.

4. What AI tools have you used before?

5. Give a specific example of how you have used AI to improve a workflow, organize information, automate part of a task, or make a repeated process easier. Do not only describe using AI to write
s.

6. What tools have you used before? For example: Gmail, Google Calendar, Google Sheets, HubSpot, Kajabi, Stripe, ClickUp, Notion, etc.

7. What is your expected monthly salary in USD?

8. Are you looking for a long-term full-time role?



Final Note



We are looking for someone who can become a valuable long-term part of our team.



The right person will help us stay organized, save time, reduce stress, improve follow-up, and create better systems across both business and family logistics.



If you are reliable, proactive, detail-oriented, and serious about using AI to work smarter, we would love to hear from you.

title: Marketing Manager
description:
Marketing Manager — Remote (Philippines)

GoodBulb | Fargo, North Dakota 

Pay: ?45,000 – ?90,000 per month (depending on experience)



About GoodBulb



GoodBulb is building something that has never existed before, America's only LED light bulb factory in Fargo, North Dakota.



For 25 years, our founder Tom Enright has been in the lighting industry. He started selling light bulbs door to door on the streets of Chicago in 2001. He spent years traveling the world, working directly with factories, learning every detail of how light bulbs are made and watching American manufacturing disappear.



So he built it back.



In July 2026, GoodBulb begins producing the only American-made A19 LED light bulb in the country. The most advanced LED bulb automation in the world. Built in North Dakota.



And part of every sale helps give light to families living without electricity. That's not a promotion. That's who we are.



We are looking for a Marketing Manager who can take this story — and run with it.



What This Role Actually Is:



You will be the person who connects Tom's vision to our creative team.



We have talented people who can design, edit video, post content, and update our website. What they need is clear direction. That's your job.



You will take Tom's ideas and turn them into:

- Detailed creative briefs for our designer (Erol)

- Posting schedules and captions for our social media team (Joyce)

- Website update instructions for our web team (Joyce and Oreo)

- Image direction for our photo editor (Abegail)

- Campaign ideas for our PPC manager



You will own the content calendar, manage the team's weekly workload, and make sure everything that goes out looks and sounds like GoodBulb — bold, purposeful, and American.



What You'll Be Responsible For



- Manage and direct our creative team daily — Erol, Joyce, Oreo, and Abegail

- Build and maintain a monthly social media content calendar

- Write creative briefs for every piece of content before it goes to the team

- Review all content before it goes live — copy, design, captions, everything

- Write or direct copy for social posts,
 campaigns, and website pages

- Coordinate product launches and promotional campaigns end to end

- Report daily to Tom on what's going out, what's live, and what's coming next

- Keep the team organized, on schedule, and producing consistently



What We're Looking For



- Excellent written English — you will be writing briefs, captions, and copy daily

- Experience managing a creative team or coordinating multiple people on projects

- Strong understanding of social media — Instagram,
, TikTok, LinkedIn

- Ability to take a rough idea and turn it into a detailed, actionable brief

- Organized, proactive, and able to work independently without constant follow-up

- Genuine interest in the GoodBulb mission — this brand runs on purpose and story

- Experience with e-commerce, DTC brands, or product marketing is a strong plus



Bonus (Not Required)



- Experience with Shopify or similar e-commerce platforms

- Experience with Klaviyo or
 marketing platforms

- Experience with Odoo or similar ERP systems

- Familiarity with Google or Meta advertising

- Experience with Amazon product listings or A+ content



How We Work



- Fast-moving — we are launching a factory in July 2026 and there is real urgency

- Tom sets the vision and priorities, you run the execution

- We value people who think ahead, flag problems early, and solve things themselves

- Clear, direct communication — no corporate speak, no fluff

- Long-term role with real opportunity to grow as GoodBulb grows



Compensation



- ?45,000 – ?90,000 PHP per month depending on experience

- Performance bonuses available as the company grows

- Long-term opportunity with a company building something historic



To Apply



Please include:



- A short description of a brand or product you have managed content for

- Two or three examples of content you have written, briefed, or directed

- A brief explanation of how you manage a creative team and keep projects on track

- Your monthly rate expectation



**Start your application with the word "Illuminate" so we know you read this.**



Application Questions



1. You have a designer, a social media poster, a web updater, and a photo editor on your team. Tom tells you: "I want to announce our factory launch for July 4th — make it big." Walk me through exactly what you do next.



2. Give me an example of a brand story you have helped tell through content. What was the story and how did you bring it to life?



3. How do you keep a remote creative team on track when everyone is working in different directions?



4. What does a good creative brief look like to you? What has to be in it before a designer or writer can start?



5. Why does the GoodBulb story matter to you personally?

# LinkedIn Content Writer for Premium Pronunciation Coaching Brand



## About Me



I run a premium pronunciation and communication coaching business focused on helping Spanish-speaking professionals in high-level careers communicate more clearly and confidently in English.



My clients are typically:



* doctors

* healthcare professionals

* engineers

* software developers

* tech professionals

* managers

* other highly skilled professionals working in the United States



The goal is not “basic English.”



The goal is helping professionals:



* sound more natural and confident

* communicate clearly in high-stakes conversations

* improve workplace communication

* reduce pronunciation-related insecurity

* feel more comfortable in meetings, presentations, interviews, and leadership environments



## What I’m Looking For



I want someone who can help create HIGH-QUALITY LinkedIn posts that feel:



* authentic

* intelligent

* conversational

* psychologically relatable

* professional without sounding corporate



I do NOT want:



* generic motivational posts

* recycled AI content

* “5 tips to improve English” type posts

* fake storytelling



The content should sound human and based on real experiences.

* Write 3 LinkedIn posts per week

* Improve hooks and formatting for engagement

* Help maintain a consistent brand voice

* Why highly skilled professionals still feel insecure speaking English in meetings

* The pronunciation patterns that make Spanish speakers harder to understand

* Why fast American speech feels impossible even for advanced English learners

* Real pronunciation breakthroughs from coaching sessions

* How communication confidence affects career growth

* Connected speech patterns native speakers use unconsciously



## Ideal Candidate



* Excellent English writing skills

* Understands LinkedIn content and audience psychology

* Can write naturally without sounding robotic

* Can match a premium/personal brand tone

* Bonus if familiar with:



  * ESL

  * pronunciation

  * communication coaching

  * immigrant professional experiences



## Hours & Pay



* Approximately 4–6 hours per week

* Long-term opportunity

* Quality is MUCH more important than quantity

* 2-3 posts a week



## To Apply



Please send:



-Examples of LinkedIn posts you’ve written

“Many Spanish-speaking professionals struggle to sound confident in English not because of grammar, but because they’ve never been taught connected speech and pronunciation patterns used by native speakers.”



I care far more about authenticity and quality than volume.

title: Amazon Trend Researcher & Designer (T-Shirts)
description:
Remote · Philippines · Full-time · ~$500/month



About the role



This is a rare opportunity to join a small, high-performing Amazon Merch on Demand business as our lead trend researcher and designer. We've been operating for nine years, we're a tight remote team, and we move fast.



Right now we're missing something important: someone dedicated to spotting what t-shirt designs (phrases and design styles) are trending on Amazon in real time and turning those ideas into live designs quickly.



This isn't a standard VA role. You'll be working directly with the business owner and with our lead researcher and designer, developing your understanding of what sells on 
 (US), what doesn't, and why. If you're someone who is self-motivated and genuinely enjoys learning as well as getting inside the Amazon ecosystem — spotting patterns, noticing American cultural trends, finding the phrase that's about to blow up — this role will suit you very well.



What you'll do day to day



— Research trending t-shirt phrases and designs on Amazon each morning using tools we provide

— Evaluate whether a trending phrase is worth creating a design for (this judgment is the core of the role)

— In your first weeks, the focus is simple: find one strong idea each day and create one design for it. Volume and variety come later where you'll be expected to find and create as many trending designs as you can (1 idea and 1 design) each day.

— Create t-shirt designs using AI image generation tools, and occasionally Photoshop for artworking and cleanup

— Upload completed design files to a shared Dropbox folder each day

— Communicate your findings and designs via async Loom videos and Slack

— Take part in a weekly call with the business owner and lead researcher and designer to align on what we're working on



What we're looking for



Primary skills (essential):

— Strong familiarity with Amazon as a shopper and researcher — you understand how and why people search, what products get clicks

— Natural pattern recognition: you notice trends, repeated phrases, what seems to be gaining 
ntum

— Self-starter who solves problems independently without needing to be told what to do next

— Excellent written and spoken English

— Reliable computer and high-speed internet



Design skills (training provided but a head start helps):

— An eye for what looks good and what looks cheap on Amazon (this is the core skill, everything else can be trained)

— Comfortable experimenting with AI image generation tools using text prompts

— Basic Photoshop for background removal, resizing, and file cleanup



Bonus (not essential):

— Previous experience with print-on-demand or Merch by Amazon

— Knowledge of Helium 10

— SEO or Amazon listing copywriting experience

— Familiarity with ClickUp or similar task tools



Working style



We're async-first. You'll receive Loom video feedback from the business owner, communicate primarily over Slack and ClickUp, and have a weekly face-to-face video call. You'll eventually work closely with the lead researcher and designer as a peer, not just under direction. We invest in people who want to grow — our lead researcher and designer started out as a pure researcher and now handles design, keyword research, and complex niche analysis. The same path is available here.



Hours are flexible as long as you're consistently producing output each working day and available for weekly calls aligned with UK working hours. Occasional time-sensitive tasks may require faster turnaround when something is trending.



How to apply



We receive a high number of applications and read every one carefully. Please do not send a generic cover letter — we find them unhelpful and they will be ignored.



Your application must include all four of the following or it won't be reviewed:



1. A short cover letter (4–8 sentences) explaining why this role suits you specifically. Somewhere in the middle of your cover letter — not at the start, not at the end — include the phrase "pixel perfect" so we know you've read this carefully.



2. Three screenshots or links to t-shirts from Amazon. Go to 
 right now and find three t-shirt designs (this means finding a phrase or design style that is trending) you think are currently trending or selling well. For each one, write two to three sentences explaining what caught your attention, whether you'd create a design for it, and how you would differentiate it. Please do this yourself — do not describe designs fro
mory.



3. A 2–3 minute Loom video. Record yourself searching for a trending t-shirt niche: this is very different to just finding a design, it's about finding and discovering a very specific sub-market on Amazon by discovering ideas from the search bar and product pages in real time. Show us how you think. You don't need a script — just walk us through your search process as you do it.



4. Your current tools and setup. Tell us what computer you use, your internet speed, and whether you have existing access to Photoshop or any AI image generation tools (tools will be provided but this is to understand your familiarity with them).



Applications missing any of the four elements above will not be considered regardless of experience level.



Salary: ~$500/month full-time, paid every two weeks. We offer a 13th month and a Christmas bonus. We're open to discussing based on experience.



We look forward to hearing from you.

title: Real Estate Cold Caller — Long-Term Role with US Investment Company
description:
About Us

We're a US-based real estate investment/wholesale company that buys houses directly from homeowners in Ohio. We're a small, fast-moving team and we're hiring a sharp, reliable cold caller to work with us long-term. If you perform well, there's real room to grow — more hours, raises, and lead-based bonuses are all on the table as we scale.



What You'll Be Doing

You'll call homeowners from a list we provide and follow a simple script. This is NOT a hard-sell role. Our leads are highly targeted — we're calling property owners who match specific criteria, so most of the heavy lifting is done before you ever dial.

Your job on each call:



Make outbound calls using our dialer (Mojo Dialer — we'll train you)

Follow our script (it's short and straightforward)

Confirm if the homeowner is open to selling their property

Ask two simple qualifying questions: timeframe and price

Hand the qualified lead off to me and my partner for the follow-up call

Log every call and lead accurately in our system



That's the entire role. We handle the deal-making, negotiating, and closing. You're the first voice they hear — we need that voice to sound professional, warm, and confident.





What We're Looking For

Required:



Fluent, clear English with minimal accent — non-negotiable. You'll be speaking with American homeowners, many of them older, and they need to understand you easily on the first try.

Confident, friendly phone presence — calm, never pushy

Reliable high-speed internet (25 Mbps or higher) and a quiet workspace

Quality USB headset with noise cancellation

Available 3 hours per day, Monday–Friday, during US Eastern Time business hours

Ability to follow a script accurately

Strong note-taking and attention to detail

Coachable — open to feedback and willing to improve



Nice to have (not required):



Previous cold calling or telemarketing experience

Previous experience in US real estate (wholesaling, acquisitions, or dispositions)

Familiarity with Mojo Dialer or similar dialers

Familiarity with Podio CRM





Why This Role Is Different

Most cold calling jobs are brutal — random lists, angry homeowners, hundreds of dials with nothing to show. Ours isn't like that. Our lists are targeted, so the conversations are generally calm. The script is short and we've removed the parts that usually trip new callers up. If you can hold a normal conversation in English, follow a simple flow, and take good notes, you'll do well here.

We respect your time. We pay on time. We don't micromanage. We just want someone reliable who shows up, follows the script, and helps us build the pipeline.





How to Apply

To apply, please send a message that includes:



A voice recording (1–2 minutes) of you introducing yourself in English and reading the following two sentences out loud:

"Hey Mr. Johnson, this is Mark. I was reaching out to see if you would be interested in selling the house on 1247 Maple Street? Awesome, thank you — while I'm getting your property pulled up, can I ask you a couple of quick questions so I can pass everything along to my partner?"

Brief answers to these questions:



Do you have previous cold calling experience? If yes, what industry and how long?

Do you have previous US real estate experience? If yes, please describe.

What is your internet speed? (Please run a quick speedtest.net and tell me the result.)

What headset/microphone setup do you use?

Are you currently working another job? If yes, are you confident you can commit to 15 hours/week during EST business hours?

What time zone are you in, and what hours can you reliably work?





?? Applications without a voice recording will not be reviewed. This is the most important part of your application.



Hiring Process



Review of voice recording and written application

Short video interview (10-15 minutes)

Paid trial week (15 hours, $4/hr) to confirm fit

Long-term hire





What I Will NOT Tolerate



Showing up late or missing scheduled shifts without notice

Going off-script or making promises to sellers we can't keep

Lying on call notes or skipping leads

Heavy accents that homeowners struggle to understand



If any of those are issues, this isn't the role for you. But if you're reliable, coachable, and want a stable long-term position with a company that treats you well — apply.

Looking forward to hearing from you.

title: Construction and Maintenance Coordinator
description:
Join Haverton Homes



Haverton Homes is a Sydney-based residential builder committed to delivering quality homes and a seamless client experience — from the first contract signing through to long after handover. We're a tight-knit team that values accountability, clear communication, and getting things done properly the first time.



About the Role



This role owns three critical touchpoints in the client journey: preparing projects for construction, keeping clients informed through the preconstruction and approval stages, and resolving any defect or maintenance matters that arise after handover.



You'll sit at the intersection of sales, design, certification, and trades — making sure projects are construction-ready on time and that every post-handover issue is handled with professionalism and care. This is a coordination-heavy role with a lot of moving parts, and success comes down to your ability to stay organised, communicate clearly, and follow through relentlessly.



Key Responsibilities

• Track preconstruction milestones and chase outstanding items to keep projects moving

• Keep clients informed through the approval stage with weekly updates on progress

• Liaise with sales, accounts, drafting, estimating, and site supervisors as required

• Upload occupation certificate documentation within one business day

• Receive, log, and triage all incoming defect and maintenance requests by urgency and warranty status

• Engage and schedule subcontractors and suppliers for warranty call-outs

• Follow up persistently until every defect item is resolved and signed off

• Acknowledge every client request within one business day and manage escalated conversations with empathy

• Maintain accurate records across monday.com, SharePoint, On-Site Companion, BuildCert Portal, and Databuild

• Produce regular reporting on the preconstruction pipeline and open defects



What We're Looking For



Essential:

• Minimum 2 years in a similar coordination, construction administration, or client services role, with preference given to those with experience in the Australian residential construction market

• Proven ability to follow and maintain checklists and workflows without cutting corners

• Strong written and verbal communication — particularly with clients, certifiers, and trades

• Highly organised with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously

• Confident chasing people for responses and holding others accountable

• Proficient with Microsoft 365 (Outlook, Excel, Teams, SharePoint)



Desirable:

• Familiarity with monday.com, On-Site Companion, BuildCert Portal, Databuild, or DocuSign

• Understanding of HIA and building warranty obligations

• Comfortable using AI tools such as Claude or Copilot to streamline admin tasks



You'll thrive in this role if you're calm under pressure, take ownership of problems through to resolution, and hold yourself to a high standard in your written communications.



Why Join Haverton Homes?

• Work on quality residential projects with a team that takes pride in the homes they deliver. 

• Be part of a growing company with a strong pipeline and a supportive, close-knit culture. 

• Opportunities for career progression and continuous learning as the business expands. 

• A collaborative environment where you'll have direct access to decision-makers and your contributions genuinely matter.

title: YouTube Video Editor/Assistant
description:
# Full-Time YouTube Video Editor for AI-Assisted Real Estate & Lifestyle Channel



We are looking for a reliable, creative, full-time video editor from the Philippines to help produce high-quality YouTube videos for a Seattle-area real estate and lifestyle channel.



This is not just basic editing. We are building a long-term content system using a mix of AI tools, real local knowledge, voiceover, b-roll, maps, stock footage, captions, and strong storytelling.



The goal is to produce **2 polished YouTube videos per week**, along with occasional short-form clips for YouTube Shorts,
, Instagram, and TikTok.



## About the Channel



Our content helps people understand what it is really like to live in Seattle, the Eastside, Snohomish County, and nearby communities. Topics include:



* Moving to Seattle

* Best Seattle suburbs

* Cost of living

* Neighborhood and city guides

* Real estate market insights

* Downsizing and preparing homes for sale

* Local lifestyle, parks, schools, commute, and community feel



The tone is calm, trustworthy, helpful, and story-driven. We are not looking for hype, clickbait, or flashy editing that feels fake. We want videos that feel professional, clear, warm, and useful.



## Main Responsibilities



You will help create **2 long-form YouTube videos per week**, usually 8–15 minutes each.



Your work may include:



* Editing long-form YouTube videos

* Finding and organizing b-roll

* Adding maps, labels, callouts, and simple motion graphics

* Using AI video tools when needed

* Editing AI avatar or AI voiceover footage

* Adding music, pacing, captions, and visual interest

* Creating short-form clips from long-form videos

* Creating clean YouTube thumbnails or helping prepare thumbnail assets

* Adding pattern interrupts every 20–30 seconds to improve retention

* Making videos feel polished, natural, and easy to watch

* Following a repeatable weekly production system



## Tools and Skills We Like



You do not need to know every tool, but you should be comfortable learning new tools quickly.



Helpful experience includes:



* Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, CapCut, or DaVinci Resolve

* Canva

* YouTube editing

* AI video tools such as HeyGen, Runway, Pika, Kling, Synthesia, or similar

* AI voiceover/video workflows

* Google Drive

* YouTube Shorts / Reels / TikTok editing

* Basic thumbnail design

* Basic map graphics or screen-recorded map editing

* Good English comprehension



## What We Are Looking For



We want someone who is:



* Full-time and dependable

* Detail-oriented

* Good at following instructions

* Creative but not overly flashy

* Comfortable working with AI tools

* Able to meet weekly deadlines

* Honest about what they can and cannot do

* Willing to learn our style

* Able to communicate clearly in English

* Looking for a long-term position, not just a short project



## Video Style



Our videos should feel:



* Professional

* Local

* Helpful

* Clear

* Trustworthy

* Warm

* Not too corporate

* Not too salesy

* Not overly dramatic



We like storytelling, clean pacing, useful visuals, maps, neighborhood footage, and simple graphics that help the viewer understand the topic.



## Weekly Output Goal



The target is:



* 2 long-form YouTube videos per week

* 2–6 short clips per week from those videos when needed

* Thumbnail support when needed



We will provide topics, direction, scripts, and guidance. You will help turn those ideas into finished videos.



## To Apply



Please reply with:



1. Your video editing experience

2. Links to 3–5 videos you have edited

3. What editing software you use

4. Any AI video tools you have used

5. Your expected full-time monthly salary in USD

6. Your internet speed and computer specs

7. Your availability and preferred work hours

8. A short answer to this question:

   **What makes a YouTube video hold attention after the first 30 seconds?**



Please include the word **SEATTLE** in the first line of your application so we know you read the full post. AI experience a plus.



## Trial Task



Shortlisted applicants may be asked to complete a paid trial edit using provided footage, script, voiceover, and direction.



We are looking for the right long-term tea
mber who wants to grow with us.

title: Senior Financial Controller (Xero) — Rebuild & Own the Finance Function of a Fast-Scaling E-commerce Brand
description:
We're an Australian premium e-commerce retailer — pool tables, arcade machines, pinball, kegerators, saunas and more. We do $10M in revenue and we're scaling to $40M over the next two years. We run our own warehousing, national delivery and an installation team. We're ambitious, we move fast, and we are dead serious about fixing our finance function properly this time.



We're looking for a Senior Financial Controller to take full ownership of our books, rebuild our Xero from the ground up, and turn it into the system the business actually steers by. This is a long-term, full-time, ongoing role. It is not a project, not a tidy-up, and not a part-time advisory seat.



READ THIS BEFORE APPLYING — WE'RE BEING COMPLETELY STRAIGHT WITH YOU



Our books are not in good shape, and we're not going to pretend otherwise. Xero is disconnected from our inventory system. Our cost of goods is inflated and nobody can fully explain why. Our chart of accounts can't show us profit by product category or by department. We've had two bookkeepers and two senior finance people through this business and the books are no better than a year ago. We have strong data sitting in our other systems — Shopify, Unleashed, Polar Analytics — but nothing ties together in Xero, and Xero is not currently a source of truth.



We are telling you this upfront because we want someone who reads that and gets interested, not nervous. If untangling a genuine mess and building order out of it is the work you're best at and enjoy most, keep reading. If you want a clean set of books to gently maintain, this is the wrong role and we'll both know it quickly.



WHAT THIS ROLE ACTUALLY IS

You will own the finance function. Not assist it — own it. In your first months the job is heavy reconstruction: you will pull apart what's wrong, rebuild the Xero chart of accounts properly, and rebuild trust in every number. Once it's clean, you run it — month-end, management accounts, cash flow, reporting — and you keep it immaculate. You'll work directly with the CEO and closely with our operations team, and you'll be the person who can answer, with confidence and evidence, “are we actually making money, and where?”



WHAT YOU'LL DELIVER

The headline outcomes we are hiring you to produce:

- Xero rebuilt as the single source of truth — a clean, correctly structured chart of accounts the leadership team trusts without second-guessing.

- Profit visibility by product category — pool tables, arcade, pinball, kegerators, dartboards, LED and furniture — so we finally know which categories make money and which don't. This is a build and depends on cost inputs being cleaned up over time; you'll be central to getting there.

- Departmental P&L — cost-centre reporting so marketing, sales, operations and admin can each see and own their numbers.

Reliable month-end — a full close and management accounts the business can make real decisions on, every month, on time.

- A 13-week rolling cash flow forecast — we have seasonal revenue and financing facilities; we need to see cash coming before it becomes a problem.



WHAT YOU'LL OWN DAY TO DAY

- Rebuilding and maintaining the Xero chart of accounts and tracking-code structure.

- Untangling cost of goods — core stock vs drop-ship, freight-in vs freight-out, installation costs, merchant fees, and the inventory adjustment journals currently muddying the picture.

- Owning the reconciliation of data flowing from Shopify and our inventory system (Unleashed) into Xero, with no unexplained variances. Our operations team owns the inventory system itself — you are the person who makes sure it reconciles cleanly into the books.

- The full month-end close and management accounts.

- The 13-week cash flow view and tracking of our financing facilities.

- Bank reconciliation, accounts payable, supplier invoice processing and payment run preparation.

- Feeding clean, reliable data to our external Australian tax accountant, who handles tax, GST and BAS.



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

This is a senior role and we need a senior person. Specifically:

- 6+ years in accounting or finance, with real depth in e-commerce, retail or inventory-heavy businesses.

- Genuine Xero mastery — you have personally restructured a chart of accounts and built a tracking-code framework, not just worked inside one someone else set up. Xero certification expected or close to it.

- A demonstrable track record of taking messy, untrusted books and making them clean and reliable — this is the single most important thing we're hiring for.

- Strong command of inventory and cost-of-goods accounting — you understand how landed cost, stock and COGS move through the books.

- Confident building cost-centre and category-level reporting from scratch.

- Hands-on with Shopify and an inventory/ERP system (Unleashed or similar).

- Self-directed and accountable — you own outcomes, surface problems early, and don't need chasing.

- Excellent written and spoken English, and genuinely confident leading a conversation on a weekly video call with the CEO.

- A reliable internet connection, a quiet space for video calls, and solid working overlap with Australian Eastern time (AEST).



WHAT'S IN IT FOR THE RIGHT PERSON

- Full ownership of a finance function from day one — this is your domain to build.

- A genuine path to a senior finance leadership seat as we scale toward $40M; we want this person to grow with us.

- A long-term, stable, full-time role with a business that's serious about getting this right and will back you to do it.

- A proper handover and structured onboarding — you will not be dropped in cold.

- Direct line to the CEO; your work will visibly drive how the business makes decisions.

- Paid local Philippine public holidays and a genuine commitment to a long-term working relationship.



HOW TO APPLY

Applications must be submitted through our application form. Applications that come only as a message here, without the form completed, will not be reviewed.



Apply here: 



We're interviewing immediately and moving quickly for the right person.

description:
ABOUT US

 

We are a family-owned hair salon based in Southern California that has been operating for over 20 years. Our specialty is color and highlight services, and our clients are primarily women aged 35 to 65 who come back to us for years.

 

Over the past year, we've built out a Meta ads funnel using GoHighLevel as our CRM and phone system, and we're now generating a steady flow of inbound leads from
 and Instagram. I'm hiring one full-time appointment setter to handle all of those leads and book them into the salon.

 

This is a long-term role. I'm looking for someone who wants to stay with us for at least a year and grow into the position.

 

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO

 

You will be the only person responsible for converting our inbound leads into booked appointments.

 

- Work inbound leads from our Meta ads through call, SMS, and DM 
 and Instagram) inside GoHighLevel

- Run our booking script as written: discovery questions, offer presentation, and the card-on-file close

- Handle objections using the framework I will train you on (reframe value, build trust, induce gentle urgency without being pushy)

- Send Stripe payment links to capture the card on file, then book the appointment in our calendar

- Charge the card on file in Stripe for any late cancels or no-shows (a few minutes per day)

- Log every interaction cleanly in the CRM so I can review conversion data and refine the script over time

 

The most important 
nt on every call is getting the card on file. Once we have it, our show rate jumps from around 55% to 90%, so that is the part of the script that matters most.

 

 

KPI TARGETS

 

This is a high-volume, metrics-driven role. You will know exactly how you are performing every day.

 

- Calls per day: 150 to 250

- Leads worked per day: 17 to 25

- Lead-to-booking rate: 25% or higher

- Show rate: 90% or higher (after card on file)

- Bookings per day: 4 to 9

- Showed appointments per month: 100 to 160

 

 

WHAT I NEED YOU TO KNOW BEFORE APPLYING

 

Script adherence is a dealbreaker. We need you to follow the script word for word on the key parts of every call. We use conversion data to test what's working and what isn't, and if everyone is freestyling their own version, the data is useless. If you have ideas to improve the script, we genuinely want to hear them, but you raise them with as feedback, not by changing things on calls. 



The schedule is fixed. Monday through Friday, 7:45 AM to 4:45 PM US Pacific Time. For someone in the Philippines, that is 11:45 PM to 8:45 AM PHT (an overnight shift). No exceptions, no shift swaps, no occasional late starts. I need someone who has actually worked overnight shifts before and knows they can sustain it for at least 12 months.

 

Tech reliability is non-negotiable. The role does not work if your internet drops two or three times a week. I will ask about your backup plan (mobile hotspot or second ISP), and we will test your connection and audio live from your actual work setup before any offer.

 

 

REQUIREMENTS

 

- 6 to 12 months of phone-based sales, appointment setting, or BPO experience (4+ hours per day on the phone)

- Clear, neutral English with strong listening skills (you'll be talking to US-based women aged 35 to 65 all day)

- Comfortable with high call volume (150 to 250 dials per day) and a long-term commitment to that pace

- Strong script discipline and comfort operating inside a defined process

- Reliable home office setup: 8GB RAM minimum (16GB preferred), wired headset with boom mic, computer mouse, internet at 25 to 50 Mbps down and 10 to 20 Mbps up, ping under 50ms, and a real backup internet plan you have actually used

- Available Monday through Friday, 7:45 AM to 4:45 PM US Pacific Time (overnight in the Philippines)

 

 NICE TO HAVE

 

- Hands-on experience with GoHighLevel (CRM and phone)

- Experience with Stripe payment links

- Background in B2C inbound sales (beauty, wellness, fitness, medspa, or salon)

- Personal interest in beauty, hair, or self-care

  

COMPENSATION

 

- Base: $900 USD per month

- Performance bonuses: $3 per new client show, $2 per existing client show, $1 per rebooking show

- Monthly threshold bonuses (cumulative): +$75 at 90 shows, +$150 at 120 shows, +$350 at 150 shows

- On-target earnings: approximately $1,300 to $1,815 per month

- PTO: 14 days per year after a 90-day probation period

- Payment: Paid through 
 on a regular schedule

- Equipment: I will buy you a headset if you need one. Computer and internet are yours.

 

To be straightforward about the structure: roughly 30 to 50% of your monthly income will come from performance bonuses. If you want a high guaranteed base with low expectations, this isn't the right fit. If you want a clear path to earn more by actually performing, the math works well here.

 

 

HOW TO APPLY

 

Submit a link to your updated resume  and Please send me a a cover letter explaining:

 

1. Your most relevant phone-based sales or appointment setting experience (how long, what industry, what volume)

2. Your history with overnight shifts and how long you sustained that schedule

3. Your home internet speeds (down/up) and your backup plan

4. Whether you can commit to the Monday through Friday, 7:45 AM to 4:45 PM PST schedule for at least 12 months

We are looking for a Video Editing VA to support our marketing and creative team by turning provided product images, graphics, banners, video footage, and short copy into simple short-form videos for ads, social media, and promotional campaigns.



This is an execution-focused role. You do not need to create full video strategies, but you should be able to follow direction, edit cleanly, organize files properly, and revise quickly based on feedback from the marketing and production team.



Responsibilities

• Create short-form videos using provided product images, graphics, banners, footage, and design assets.

• Edit simple 15-60 second videos for ads, social media, and promotional campaigns.

• Add text overlays, captions, CTA, music, basic motion, and clean transitions.

• Resize and export videos for Meta, TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts.

• Comfortable following brand direction, creative references, and revision notes.

• Strong organization and ability to work quickly on multiple creative requests.



Application Requirements

Applicants must submit the following materials:

• Resume or CV

• Two short-form video samples with a brief explanation of your role in each sample.

• Required test assignment using the Google Drive footage and the suggested copy provided below.

• Concept: Interior Protection + Premium Upgrade



Creative Direction

• Clean, modern, and premium.

Must Include

• Headline

• CTA

• Background music or simple sound design



What We Will Review

• Product clarity

• Readable text

• Smooth pacing

• Clean design

• Ability to follow the requested concept and direction

• Organization and overall polish



Ideal Candidate

We are looking for someone who can support a fast-moving marketing and creative team with clean, simple, and efficient video edits for advertising and social media content. The ideal candidate can follow direction well, make revisions accurately, stay organized, and execute creative requests quickly while maintaining a polished and premium feel.



How to Apply

Please submit your application through the V2 messaging system.

Your message must include:
